metadata.name: shopify__customer_cohorts
metadata.comment: Each record represents a customer's performance in a calendar month.

date_month.name: date_month
date_month.comment: The calendar month the customer stats relate to.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.comment: The ID of the related customer.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp of the customer's first order.

cohort_month.name: cohort_month
cohort_month.comment: The month the cohort belongs to, i.e the first month the customer had an order.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

order_count_in_month.name: order_count_in_month
order_count_in_month.comment: Number of orders purchased in the `date_month`

total_price_in_month.name: total_price_in_month
total_price_in_month.comment: Total amount (in shop currency) purchased in the `date_month`

line_item_count_in_month.name: line_item_count_in_month
line_item_count_in_month.comment: Number of line items purchased in the `date_month`

total_price_lifetime.name: total_price_lifetime
total_price_lifetime.comment: Total amount (in shop currency) up until and including this `date_month`.

order_count_lifetime.name: order_count_lifetime
order_count_lifetime.comment: Number of orders purchased up until and including this `date_month`.

line_item_count_lifetime.name: line_item_count_lifetime
line_item_count_lifetime.comment: Number of line items purchased up until and including this `date_month`.

cohort_month_number.name: cohort_month_number
cohort_month_number.comment: The 'number' of the `date_month` of the record, i.e. how many months from their start month this cohort occurred

customer_cohort_id.name: customer_cohort_id
customer_cohort_id.comment: Unique key representing a customer in a given month. Hashed on 'date_month', 'customer_id', and 'source_relation'.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: shopify__customer_emails
metadata.comment: Each record represents a customer email in Shopify. Does **not** include `CUSTOMER` metafields.

email.name: email
email.comment: The unique email address of the customer.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

customer_ids.name: customer_ids
customer_ids.comment: Comma-separated list of customer IDs associated with the email.

phone_numbers.name: phone_numbers
phone_numbers.comment: Comma-separated list of phone numbers associated with this email.

customer_tags.name: customer_tags
customer_tags.comment: A string aggregated list of all tags associated with a customer.

first_account_created_at.name: first_account_created_at
first_account_created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the first account associated with this email was created.

last_account_created_at.name: last_account_created_at
last_account_created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the last account associated with this email was created.

last_updated_at.name: last_updated_at
last_updated_at.comment: The date and time when the customer information was last updated.

marketing_consent_updated_at.name: marketing_consent_updated_at
marketing_consent_updated_at.comment: The date and time when the customer consented to receive marketing material by email. If no date is provided, then the date and time when the consent information was sent is used.

last_fivetran_synced.name: last_fivetran_synced
last_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

is_tax_exempt.name: is_tax_exempt
is_tax_exempt.comment: Whether the customer is exempt from paying taxes on their order. If true, then taxes won't be applied to an order at checkout. If false, then taxes will be applied at checkout.

is_verified_email.name: is_verified_email
is_verified_email.comment: Whether the customer has verified their email address.

default_address_id.name: default_address_id
default_address_id.comment: The default address for the customer.

account_state.name: account_state
account_state.comment: The state of the customer's account with a shop.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency that the customer used when they paid for their last order. Defaults to the shop currency. Returns the shop currency for test orders.

marketing_consent_state.name: marketing_consent_state
marketing_consent_state.comment: Field indicating if the customer has consented to receive marketing material via email. Coalescing of the new `email_marketing_consent_state` field and the deprecated `accepts_marketing` field. Records with the old field will be marked with '(legacy)'.

marketing_opt_in_level.name: marketing_opt_in_level
marketing_opt_in_level.comment: The marketing subscription opt-in level, as described in the M3AAWG Sender Best Common Practices, that the customer gave when they consented to receive marketing material by email.

lifetime_abandoned_checkouts.name: lifetime_abandoned_checkouts
lifetime_abandoned_checkouts.comment: Total number of abandoned checkouts abandoned by the customer.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp the customer completed their first order.

most_recent_order_timestamp.name: most_recent_order_timestamp
most_recent_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp the customer completed their most recent order.

avg_order_value.name: avg_order_value
avg_order_value.comment: The average order value for the customer.

lifetime_total_spent.name: lifetime_total_spent
lifetime_total_spent.comment: The total amount of money that the customer has spent on orders across their order history (in shop currency).

lifetime_total_refunded.name: lifetime_total_refunded
lifetime_total_refunded.comment: The total amount of money that the customer has been refunded on orders across their order history.

lifetime_total_net.name: lifetime_total_net
lifetime_total_net.comment: The total amount of money (minus refunds) that the customer has spent across their order history.

lifetime_count_orders.name: lifetime_count_orders
lifetime_count_orders.comment: The number of orders associated with this customer.

avg_quantity_per_order.name: avg_quantity_per_order
avg_quantity_per_order.comment: Average quantity of items per order customer orders.

lifetime_total_tax.name: lifetime_total_tax
lifetime_total_tax.comment: Total amount of tax attributed to the customer.

avg_tax_per_order.name: avg_tax_per_order
avg_tax_per_order.comment: Average tax per order attributed to the customer.

lifetime_total_discount.name: lifetime_total_discount
lifetime_total_discount.comment: Total discounts attributed to the customer.

avg_discount_per_order.name: avg_discount_per_order
avg_discount_per_order.comment: Average discount per order attributed to the customer.

lifetime_total_shipping.name: lifetime_total_shipping
lifetime_total_shipping.comment: Total shipping costs attributed to the customer.

avg_shipping_per_order.name: avg_shipping_per_order
avg_shipping_per_order.comment: Average shipping cost per order attributed to the customer.

lifetime_total_shipping_with_discounts.name: lifetime_total_shipping_with_discounts
lifetime_total_shipping_with_discounts.comment: Total shipping costs after discounts attributed to the customer.

avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order.name: avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order
avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order.comment: Average shipping costs after discounts per order attributed to the customer.

lifetime_total_shipping_tax.name: lifetime_total_shipping_tax
lifetime_total_shipping_tax.comment: Total shipping tax attributed to the customer.

avg_shipping_tax_per_order.name: avg_shipping_tax_per_order
avg_shipping_tax_per_order.comment: Average shipping tax per order attributed to the customer.

created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601) when the shop was created.

count_orders.name: count_orders
count_orders.comment: Count of the distinct orders placed on this day.

count_line_items.name: count_line_items
count_line_items.comment: Count of the line items included in orders placed on this day.

avg_line_item_count.name: avg_line_item_count
avg_line_item_count.comment: Average line item count for orders placed on this day.

count_customers.name: count_customers

count_customer_emails.name: count_customer_emails
count_customer_emails.comment: Count of distinct customer email addresses who placed an order on this day.

order_adjusted_total.name: order_adjusted_total
order_adjusted_total.comment: Order total adjusted for refunds and other adjustments. The calculation used for this field is as follows: total price listed on the original order (including shipping costs and discounts) + adjustments + adjustments tax - total refunds - refunds tax The order_adjusted_total will equate to the total sales - refunds listed within the transactions table for the order (after currency exchange).

avg_order_value.name: avg_order_value
avg_order_value.comment: Average adjusted total per order placed on this day (in shop currency).

shipping_cost.name: shipping_cost
shipping_cost.comment: The shipping cost of the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

order_adjustment_amount.name: order_adjustment_amount
order_adjustment_amount.comment: Total adjustment amount (in shop currency) applied to the orders placed on this day.

order_adjustment_tax_amount.name: order_adjustment_tax_amount
order_adjustment_tax_amount.comment: Total tax applied to adjustments (in shop currency) on the orders placed on this day.

refund_subtotal.name: refund_subtotal
refund_subtotal.comment: Total refund amount applied to the orders placed on this day.

refund_total_tax.name: refund_total_tax
refund_total_tax.comment: Total tax applied to the refund on the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

total_discounts.name: total_discounts
total_discounts.comment: The total amount of the discount allocated to this day's orders in the shop's currency.

avg_discount.name: avg_discount
avg_discount.comment: Average total discount placed on orders on this day (in shop currency).

shipping_discount_amount.name: shipping_discount_amount
shipping_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping for orders placed on this day.

avg_shipping_discount_amount.name: avg_shipping_discount_amount
avg_shipping_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping on orders placed on this day.

percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: percentage_calc_discount_amount
percentage_calc_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based discount for orders placed on this day.

avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount
avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based-discount on orders placed on this day.

fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: fixed_amount_discount_amount
fixed_amount_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount discount for orders placed on this day.

avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount
avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount-discount on orders placed on this day.

count_discount_codes_applied.name: count_discount_codes_applied
count_discount_codes_applied.comment: Distinct discount codes applied by customers on orders for this day.

count_locations_ordered_from.name: count_locations_ordered_from
count_locations_ordered_from.comment: Distinct locations with orders placed against them on this day.

count_orders_with_discounts.name: count_orders_with_discounts
count_orders_with_discounts.comment: Count of orders in which a discount was applied.

count_orders_with_refunds.name: count_orders_with_refunds
count_orders_with_refunds.comment: Count of orders in which there was a refund.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: Timestamp of the first order of the day for the shop.

last_order_timestamp.name: last_order_timestamp
last_order_timestamp.comment: Timestamp of the last order of the day for the shop.

quantity_sold.name: quantity_sold
quantity_sold.comment: Total quantity sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

quantity_refunded.name: quantity_refunded
quantity_refunded.comment: The quantity of goods ORDERED on this day that have been refunded.

quantity_net.name: quantity_net
quantity_net.comment: Net quantity sold from this shop on this day. Excludes refunds.

avg_quantity_sold.name: avg_quantity_sold
avg_quantity_sold.comment: Average quantity sold per order on this day. Includes refunds. (in shop currency)

avg_quantity_net.name: avg_quantity_net
avg_quantity_net.comment: Average net quantity sold per order on this day. Excludes refunds. (in shop currency)

count_variants_sold.name: count_variants_sold
count_variants_sold.comment: Distinct product variants sold on this day (includes refunds).

count_products_sold.name: count_products_sold
count_products_sold.comment: Distinct products sold on this day (includes refunds).

quantity_gift_cards_sold.name: quantity_gift_cards_sold
quantity_gift_cards_sold.comment: Quantity of gift cards sold on this day.

quantity_requiring_shipping.name: quantity_requiring_shipping
quantity_requiring_shipping.comment: Quantity of goods sold on this day that require shipping.

gross_sales.name: gross_sales
gross_sales.comment: The total revenue from sales before discounts and returns are applied for this day (in shop currency).

discounts.name: discounts
discounts.comment: The total amount of discounts applied to orders on this day (in shop currency).

returns.name: returns
returns.comment: The total value of goods returned on orders on this day (in shop currency).

net_sales.name: net_sales
net_sales.comment: The net revenue from orders on this day after discounts and returns (gross_sales - discounts - returns, in shop currency).

count_abandoned_checkouts.name: count_abandoned_checkouts
count_abandoned_checkouts.comment: Count of abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customers_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customers_abandoned_checkout
count_customers_abandoned_checkout.comment: Count of distinct customers who abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout
count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.comment: Count of distinct customer emails who abandoned checkouts on this day.

metadata.name: shopify__discounts
metadata.comment: Each record represents a unique discount, enriched with discount metadata and metrics regarding orders and abandoned checkouts.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

discount_code_id.name: discount_code_id
discount_code_id.comment: The ID for the discount code.

applies_once_per_customer.name: applies_once_per_customer
applies_once_per_customer.comment: Whether the discount can be used only once per customer.

usage_count.name: usage_count
usage_count.comment: Number of times the discount has been used (asynchronously updated).

codes_count.name: codes_count
codes_count.comment: Number of unique redeem codes associated with the discount.

codes_precision.name: codes_precision
codes_precision.comment: Indicates whether `codes_count` is exact or estimated.

combines_with_order_discounts.name: combines_with_order_discounts
combines_with_order_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with order-level discounts.

combines_with_product_discounts.name: combines_with_product_discounts
combines_with_product_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with product-level discounts.

combines_with_shipping_discounts.name: combines_with_shipping_discounts
combines_with_shipping_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with shipping-level discounts.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount was created.

customer_selection_all_customers.name: customer_selection_all_customers
customer_selection_all_customers.comment: Whether the discount is available to all customers.

ends_at.name: ends_at
ends_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount ends or expires.

starts_at.name: starts_at
starts_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount becomes active.

status.name: status
status.comment: Current status of the discount (e.g. 'active', 'expired', 'scheduled').

title.name: title
title.comment: The discount’s display name in the Shopify admin and to customers.

total_sales_amount.name: total_sales_amount
total_sales_amount.comment: The total sales amount that resulted from the usage of this discount.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount was last updated.

usage_limit.name: usage_limit
usage_limit.comment: The total number of times the discount code can be used.

code.name: code
code.comment: The case-insensitive discount code that customers use at checkout.

allocation_method.name: allocation_method
allocation_method.comment: The method by which the discount is allocated. Valid values include `each` (applies the discount to each eligible item) and `across` (spreads the discount value across eligible items).

description.name: description
description.comment: A description of the discount, often corresponding to the rule or promotion name.

target_selection.name: target_selection
target_selection.comment: Indicates whether the discount applies to 'all' or 'entitled' items.

target_type.name: target_type
target_type.comment: The type of target this discount applies to (e.g., `line_item` or `shipping_line`).

value.name: value
value.comment: Numeric value of the discount (e.g., percentage or fixed amount).

value_type.name: value_type
value_type.comment: How the discount value is interpreted (e.g., 'percentage', 'fixed_amount').

discounts_unique_key.name: discounts_unique_key
discounts_unique_key.comment:
Unique key representing a discount.
Hashed on 'source_relation', 'discount_code_id', 'discount_id', 'discount_type',
'code', 'allocation_method', 'description', 'target_selection', 'target_type',
'type', 'value', 'value_type'.

count_orders.name: count_orders
count_orders.comment: Count of orders in which this discount code was applied.

avg_order_discount_amount.name: avg_order_discount_amount
avg_order_discount_amount.comment: Average amount (in shop currency) of discount taken off orders.

total_order_discount_amount.name: total_order_discount_amount
total_order_discount_amount.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off of orders.

total_order_line_items_price.name: total_order_line_items_price
total_order_line_items_price.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of line items for orders that have used this discount.

total_order_shipping_cost.name: total_order_shipping_cost
total_order_shipping_cost.comment: Total shipping costs for orders that used this discount.

total_order_refund_amount.name: total_order_refund_amount
total_order_refund_amount.comment: Total refunded amount (in shop currency) for orders that used this discount code.

count_customers.name: count_customers
count_customers.comment: Count of distinct customers who placed orders using this discount.

count_customer_emails.name: count_customer_emails
count_customer_emails.comment: Count of distinct customer emails who placed orders using this discount.

total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.name: total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount
total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off abandoned checkout orders.

total_abandoned_checkout_shipping_price.name: total_abandoned_checkout_shipping_price
total_abandoned_checkout_shipping_price.comment: Total projected shipping costs for abandoned checkouts that applied this discount first.

count_abandoned_checkouts.name: count_abandoned_checkouts
count_abandoned_checkouts.comment: Count of abandoned checkouts in which this discount code was applied.

count_abandoned_checkout_customers.name: count_abandoned_checkout_customers
count_abandoned_checkout_customers.comment: Distinct count of customers who applied this discount in a checkout that they abandoned.

count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails.name: count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails
count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails.comment: Distinct count of customer emails who applied this discount in a checkout that they abandoned.

metadata.name: shopify__inventory_levels
metadata.comment:
Model representing the current status of an inventory level in Shopify. Inventory Levels are unique pairings of  inventory items (which have a 1:1 relationship with product variants) and locations. 
Inventory Level = Inventory item @ a Location.
Will also include `PRODUCT_VARIANT` metafields if enabled.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.comment: The ID of the inventory item associated with the inventory level.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The ID of the location that the inventory level belongs to.

can_deactivate.name: can_deactivate
can_deactivate.comment: Indicates whether the inventory item can be deactivated at the location.

deactivation_alert.name: deactivation_alert
deactivation_alert.comment: Provides an alert message when the inventory item is deactivated at the location.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time when the inventory level was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory level was last modified.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

sku.name: sku
sku.comment: The unique SKU (stock keeping unit) of the inventory item.

is_inventory_item_deleted.name: is_inventory_item_deleted
is_inventory_item_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

unit_cost_amount.name: unit_cost_amount
unit_cost_amount.comment: The unit cost associated with the inventory item.

unit_cost_currency_code.name: unit_cost_currency_code
unit_cost_currency_code.comment: Currency of the unit cost associated with the inventory item.

country_code_of_origin.name: country_code_of_origin
country_code_of_origin.comment: The country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of where the item came from.

province_code_of_origin.name: province_code_of_origin
province_code_of_origin.comment: The province code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2) of where the item came from. The province code is only used if the shipping provider for the inventory item is Canada Post.

is_shipping_required.name: is_shipping_required
is_shipping_required.comment: (DEPRECATED 2025-01-06) Boolean representing whether a customer needs to provide a shipping address when placing an order containing the inventory item.

is_inventory_quantity_tracked.name: is_inventory_quantity_tracked
is_inventory_quantity_tracked.comment: Boolean representing whether inventory levels are tracked for the item. If true, then the inventory quantity changes are tracked by Shopify.

inventory_item_created_at.name: inventory_item_created_at
inventory_item_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was created.

inventory_item_updated_at.name: inventory_item_updated_at
inventory_item_updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was last modified.

duplicate_sku_count.name: duplicate_sku_count
duplicate_sku_count.comment: The number of inventory items that share the same SKU with this item.

harmonized_system_code.name: harmonized_system_code
harmonized_system_code.comment: The harmonized system code of the item.

inventory_history_url.name: inventory_history_url
inventory_history_url.comment: The URL that points to the inventory history for the item.

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id
legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

measurement_id.name: measurement_id
measurement_id.comment: The unique identifier for the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_value.name: measurement_weight_value
measurement_weight_value.comment: The weight value of the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_unit.name: measurement_weight_unit
measurement_weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the inventory item's weight.

is_tracked_editable_locked.name: is_tracked_editable_locked
is_tracked_editable_locked.comment: Indicates whether the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

tracked_editable_reason.name: tracked_editable_reason
tracked_editable_reason.comment: Provides the reason why the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

is_location_deleted.name: is_location_deleted
is_location_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

is_location_active.name: is_location_active
is_location_active.comment: Boolean representing whether the location is active. If true, then the location can be used to sell products, stock inventory, and fulfill orders.

address_2.name: address_2
address_2.comment: The optional second line of the location's street address.

city.name: city
city.comment: The city the location is in.

country.name: country
country.comment: The country the location is in (two-letter code).

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format) corresponding to country the location is in.

is_legacy_location.name: is_legacy_location
is_legacy_location.comment: Boolean representing whether this is a fulfillment service location. If true, then the location is a fulfillment service location.  If false, then the location was created by the merchant and isn't tied to a fulfillment service.

province.name: province
province.comment: The province, state, or district of the location.

province_code.name: province_code
province_code.comment: The province, state, or district code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 format) of the location.

phone.name: phone
phone.comment: The phone number of the location. This value can contain special characters, such as - or +.

location_created_at.name: location_created_at
location_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the location was created.

location_updated_at.name: location_updated_at
location_updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the location was last updated.

variant_id.name: variant_id
variant_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the product variant.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the product.

variant_title.name: variant_title
variant_title.comment: The title of the product variant. The title field is a concatenation of the option1, option2, and option3 fields. You can only update title indirectly using the option fields.

variant_inventory_policy.name: variant_inventory_policy
variant_inventory_policy.comment: Whether customers are allowed to place an order for the product variant when it's out of stock.

variant_price.name: variant_price
variant_price.comment: The price of the product variant in shop currency.

is_variant_taxable.name: is_variant_taxable
is_variant_taxable.comment: Whether a tax is charged when the product variant is sold.

variant_barcode.name: variant_barcode
variant_barcode.comment: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product.

variant_inventory_quantity.name: variant_inventory_quantity
variant_inventory_quantity.comment: An aggregate of inventory across all locations. To adjust inventory at a specific location, use the InventoryLevel resource.

variant_tax_code.name: variant_tax_code
variant_tax_code.comment: This parameter applies only to the stores that have the Avalara AvaTax app installed. Specifies the Avalara tax code for the product variant.

variant_created_at.name: variant_created_at
variant_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product variant was created.

variant_updated_at.name: variant_updated_at
variant_updated_at.comment: The date and time when the product variant was last modified. Gets returned in ISO 8601 format.

variant_is_available_for_sale.name: variant_is_available_for_sale
variant_is_available_for_sale.comment: Indicates whether the product variant is available for sale.

variant_display_name.name: variant_display_name
variant_display_name.comment: The display name of the variant, based on the product's title and variant's title.

variant_legacy_resource_id.name: variant_legacy_resource_id
variant_legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

variant_has_components_required.name: variant_has_components_required
variant_has_components_required.comment: Indicates whether a product variant requires components.

variant_sellable_online_quantity.name: variant_sellable_online_quantity
variant_sellable_online_quantity.comment: The total sellable quantity of the variant for online channels.

subtotal_sold.name: subtotal_sold
subtotal_sold.comment: Total amount (monetary, in shop currency) sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

quantity_sold.name: quantity_sold
quantity_sold.comment: Total quantity sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

count_distinct_orders.name: count_distinct_orders
count_distinct_orders.comment: The number of distinct orders placed from this inventory level.

count_distinct_customers.name: count_distinct_customers
count_distinct_customers.comment: The number of distinct customers (based on customer_id) that have placed orders against this inventory level.

count_distinct_customer_emails.name: count_distinct_customer_emails
count_distinct_customer_emails.comment: The number of distinct customer emails that have placed orders against this inventory level.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: The timetamp of the first order against this inventory level.

last_order_timestamp.name: last_order_timestamp
last_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp of the first order against this inventory level.

subtotal_sold_refunds.name: subtotal_sold_refunds
subtotal_sold_refunds.comment: The monetary amount (in shop currency) of inventory level goods that have been refunded.

quantity_sold_refunds.name: quantity_sold_refunds
quantity_sold_refunds.comment: The quantity of inventory level goods that have been refunded.

count_fulfillment_pending.name: count_fulfillment_pending
count_fulfillment_pending.comment: Count of currently pending distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Pending" = Shopify has created the fulfillment and is waiting for the third-party fulfillment service to transition it to 'open' or 'success'.

count_fulfillment_open.name: count_fulfillment_open
count_fulfillment_open.comment: Count of currently open distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Open" = The fulfillment has been acknowledged by the service and is in processing.

count_fulfillment_success.name: count_fulfillment_success
count_fulfillment_success.comment: Count of successful distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Success" = The fulfillment was successful.

count_fulfillment_cancelled.name: count_fulfillment_cancelled
count_fulfillment_cancelled.comment: Count of cancelled distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Cancelled" = The fulfillment was cancelled.

count_fulfillment_error.name: count_fulfillment_error
count_fulfillment_error.comment: Count of distinct fulfillments for this inventory level that encountered an error. "Error" = There was an error with the fulfillment request.

count_fulfillment_failure.name: count_fulfillment_failure
count_fulfillment_failure.comment: Count of distinct fulfillments for this inventory level that failed. "Failure" = The fulfillment request failed.

incoming_quantity.name: incoming_quantity
incoming_quantity.comment: The incoming quantity on its way to a merchant's location. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

on_hand_quantity.name: on_hand_quantity
on_hand_quantity.comment: The total number of units that are physically at a location. The `on_hand` state equals the sum of inventory quantities that  are in the `available`, `committed`, `reserved`, `damaged`, `safety_stock`, and `quality_control` states. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

available_quantity.name: available_quantity
available_quantity.comment: The available quantity that a merchant can sell, where inventory_state_name = 'available' from `stg_shopify__inventory_quantity`. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

committed_quantity.name: committed_quantity
committed_quantity.comment: The number of units that are part of a placed order but aren't fulfilled. When a draft order is created, the inventory isn't committed until the draft order is completed and an order is created. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

reserved_quantity.name: reserved_quantity
reserved_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that are temporarily set aside. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

damaged_quantity.name: damaged_quantity
damaged_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that aren't sellable or usable due to damage. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

safety_stock_quantity.name: safety_stock_quantity
safety_stock_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that are set aside to help guard against overselling. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

quality_control_quantity.name: quality_control_quantity
quality_control_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that aren't sellable because they're currently in inspection for quality purposes. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

net_subtotal_sold.name: net_subtotal_sold
net_subtotal_sold.comment: Net monetary amount sold (in shop currency) from the inventory level. Excludes refunds.

net_quantity_sold.name: net_quantity_sold
net_quantity_sold.comment: Net quantity sold from this inventory level. Excludes refunds.

metadata.name: shopify__line_item_enhanced
metadata.comment: This model constructs a comprehensive, denormalized analytical table that enables reporting on key revenue, customer, and product metrics from your billing platform. It’s designed to align with the schema of the `*__line_item_enhanced` model found in Shopify, Recharge, Stripe, Zuora, and Recurly, offering standardized reporting across various billing platforms. To see the kinds of insights this model can generate, explore example visualizations in the [Fivetran Billing Model Streamlit App](https://fivetran-billing-model.streamlit.app/). Visit the app for more details.

line_item_index.name: line_item_index
line_item_index.comment: Unique index of each line item id for each order.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: When the order was created

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: Currency used in the order.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: Product ID

quantity.name: quantity
quantity.comment: The number of units of this line item.

unit_amount.name: unit_amount
unit_amount.comment: Amount per unit, or the price.

discount_amount.name: discount_amount
discount_amount.comment: The discount amount associated with this order.

tax_amount.name: tax_amount
tax_amount.comment: The tax amount associated with this order.

payment_method_id.name: payment_method_id
payment_method_id.comment: Shopify does not have a particular payment_method_id, therefore all records will be null.

payment_method.name: payment_method
payment_method.comment: Transaction gateway for Shopify ('gift card', 'shopify payments', etc)

fee_amount.name: fee_amount
fee_amount.comment: The total shipping fee associated with the order.

refund_amount.name: refund_amount
refund_amount.comment: Refund amount associated with this order.

subscription_id.name: subscription_id
subscription_id.comment: Shopify does not include subscriptions, therefore all records will be null.

subscription_plan.name: subscription_plan

variant_updated_at.name: variant_updated_at

variant_compare_at_price.name: variant_compare_at_price
variant_compare_at_price.comment: The original price of the item before an adjustment or a sale in shop currency.

variant_is_taxable.name: variant_is_taxable
variant_is_taxable.comment: Whether a tax is charged when the product variant is sold.

variant_barcode.name: variant_barcode
variant_barcode.comment: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product.

variant_inventory_quantity.name: variant_inventory_quantity
variant_inventory_quantity.comment: An aggregate of inventory across all locations. To adjust inventory at a specific location, use the InventoryLevel resource.

variant_tax_code.name: variant_tax_code
variant_tax_code.comment: This parameter applies only to the stores that have the Avalara AvaTax app installed. Specifies the Avalara tax code for the product variant.

variant_is_available_for_sale.name: variant_is_available_for_sale
variant_is_available_for_sale.comment: Indicates whether the product variant is available for sale.

variant_legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

variant_sellable_online_quantity.name: variant_sellable_online_quantity

metadata.name: shopify__orders
metadata.comment: Each record represents an order in Shopify. Will also include `ORDER` metafields if enabled.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The ID of the order, used for API purposes. This is different from the order_number property, which is the ID used by the shop owner and customer.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The ID of the user logged into Shopify POS who processed the order, if applicable.

total_discounts.name: total_discounts
total_discounts.comment: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in the shop currency.

total_discounts_set.name: total_discounts_set
total_discounts_set.comment: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_line_items_price.name: total_line_items_price
total_line_items_price.comment: The sum of all line item prices in the shop currency.

total_line_items_price_set.name: total_line_items_price_set
total_line_items_price_set.comment: The total of all line item prices in shop and presentment currencies.

total_price.name: total_price
total_price.comment: The sum of all line item prices, discounts, shipping, taxes, and tips in the shop currency. Must be positive.

total_price_set.name: total_price_set
total_price_set.comment: The total price of the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_tax_set.name: total_tax_set
total_tax_set.comment: The total tax applied to the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_tax.name: total_tax
total_tax.comment: The sum of all the taxes applied to the order in th shop currency. Must be positive.

source_name.name: source_name
source_name.comment: Where the order originated. Can be set only during order creation, and is not writeable afterwards.

subtotal_price.name: subtotal_price
subtotal_price.comment: The price of the order in the shop currency after discounts but before shipping, taxes, and tips.

has_taxes_included.name: has_taxes_included
has_taxes_included.comment: Whether taxes are included in the order subtotal.

total_weight.name: total_weight
total_weight.comment: The sum of all line item weights in grams.

total_tip_received.name: total_tip_received
total_tip_received.comment: The sum of all the tips in the order in the shop currency.

landing_site_base_url.name: landing_site_base_url
landing_site_base_url.comment: The URL for the page where the buyer landed when they entered the shop.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The ID of the physical location where the order was processed.

name.name: name

note.name: note

number.name: number
number.comment: The order's position in the shop's count of orders. Numbers are sequential and start at 1.

order_number.name: order_number
order_number.comment: The order 's position in the shop's count of orders starting at 1001. Order numbers are sequential and start at 1001.

cancel_reason.name: cancel_reason

cart_token.name: cart_token
cart_token.comment: The ID of the cart that's associated with the order.

checkout_token.comment: The checkout token applied to the order.

cancelled_timestamp.name: cancelled_timestamp

closed_timestamp.name: closed_timestamp
closed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the order was closed (archived).

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code for the shop currency.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.comment: The ID of the order's customer.

financial_status.name: financial_status
financial_status.comment: The status of payments associated with the order. Can only be set when the order is created

fulfillment_status.name: fulfillment_status

referring_site.name: referring_site
referring_site.comment: The website where the customer clicked a link to the shop.

billing_address_longitude.comment: The longitude of the billing address.

billing_address_name.comment: The full name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_province.name: billing_address_province

billing_address_province_code.name: billing_address_province_code
billing_address_province_code.comment: The two-letter abbreviation of the region of the billing address.

billing_address_zip.name: billing_address_zip
billing_address_zip.comment: The postal code (zip, postcode, Eircode, …) of the billing address.

total_shipping_price_set.comment: The total shipping price set to the order.

shipping_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_company.comment: The company of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_country.comment: The name of the country of the shipping address.

shipping_address_country_code.name: shipping_address_country_code
shipping_address_country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the shipping address.

shipping_address_first_name.name: shipping_address_first_name
shipping_address_first_name.comment: The first name of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_last_name.name: shipping_address_last_name
shipping_address_last_name.comment: The last name of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_latitude.comment: The latitude of the shipping address.

shipping_address_longitude.comment: The longitude of the shipping address.

shipping_address_name.comment: The full name of the person associated with the payment method.

shipping_address_phone.name: shipping_address_phone

shipping_address_province.name: shipping_address_province

shipping_address_province_code.name: shipping_address_province_code
shipping_address_province_code.comment: The two-letter abbreviation of the region of the shipping address.

shipping_address_zip.name: shipping_address_zip
shipping_address_zip.comment: The postal code (zip, postcode, Eircode, …) of the shipping address.

app_id.comment: The ID of the app that created the order.

client_details_user_agent.comment: Details of the browsing client, including software and operating versions.

order_status_url.comment: The URL pointing to the order status web page, if applicable.

is_test_order.comment: Whether this is a test order.

order_adjustment_amount.comment: Total adjustment amount applied to the order in shop currency.

order_adjustment_tax_amount.comment: Total tax applied to the adjustment on the order in shop currency.

refund_subtotal.comment: Total refund amount applied to the order in shop currency.

refund_total_tax.comment: Total tax applied to the refund on the order in shop currency.

shipping_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping.

order_url_tags.comment: List of url tags associated with the order.

tracking_companies.comment: List of tracking companies for the order.

tracking_numbers.name: tracking_numbers
tracking_numbers.comment: List of tracking numbers for the order.

gross_sales.comment: The total revenue from sales before discounts and returns are applied (in shop currency).

discounts.comment: The total amount of discounts applied to the order (in shop currency).

returns.comment: The total value of goods returned on the order (in shop currency).

net_sales.comment: The net revenue from the order after discounts and returns (gross_sales - discounts - returns, in shop currency).

customer_order_seq_number.comment: The sequential number of the order as it relates to the customer

handle.name: handle
handle.comment: A unique human-friendly string for the product. Automatically generated from the product's title.

product_type.name: product_type

published_scope.name: published_scope
published_scope.comment: (DEPRECATED) Whether the product is published to the Point of Sale channel. This field now returns null following a connector update and will be removed in a future release.

title.name: title
title.comment: The name of the product.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.comment: The name of the product's vendor.

status.comment: The status of the product. Valid values: - active: The product is ready to sell and is available to customers on the online store, sales channels, and apps. By default, existing products are set to active. - archived: The product is no longer being sold and isn't available to customers on sales channels and apps. - draft: The product isn't ready to sell and is unavailable to customers on sales channels and apps. By default, duplicated and unarchived products are set to draft.

updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was last modified.

published_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be set to null to unpublish the product from the Online Store channel.

avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order.name: avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order
avg_shipping_with_discounts_per_order.comment: Average shipping costs after discounts per order attributed to the customer.

lifetime_total_shipping_tax.name: lifetime_total_shipping_tax
lifetime_total_shipping_tax.comment: Total shipping tax attributed to the customer.

avg_shipping_tax_per_order.name: avg_shipping_tax_per_order
avg_shipping_tax_per_order.comment: Average shipping tax per order attributed to the customer.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: shopify_gql__daily_shop
metadata.comment: Each record represents a day in your Shop, enriched with a suite of metrics. Will also include `SHOP` metafields if enabled.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day for which the shop activity is being measured.

shop_id.name: shop_id
shop_id.comment: The ID for the shop. A 64-bit unsigned integer.

name.name: name
name.comment: The name of the shop.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop's default currency.

enabled_presentment_currencies.name: enabled_presentment_currencies
enabled_presentment_currencies.comment: An array of of enabled currencies (ISO 4217 format) that the shop accepts. Merchants can enable currencies from their Shopify Payments settings in the Shopify Admin.

iana_timezone.name: iana_timezone
iana_timezone.comment: The name of the timezone assigned by the [IANA](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601) when the shop was created.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

count_orders.name: count_orders
count_orders.comment: Count of the distinct orders placed on this day.

count_line_items.name: count_line_items
count_line_items.comment: Count of the line items included in orders placed on this day.

avg_line_item_count.name: avg_line_item_count
avg_line_item_count.comment: Average line item count for orders placed on this day.

count_customers.name: count_customers
count_customers.comment: Count of distinct customers who placed an order on this day.

count_customer_emails.name: count_customer_emails
count_customer_emails.comment: Count of distinct customer email addresses who placed an order on this day.

order_adjusted_total.name: order_adjusted_total
order_adjusted_total.comment: Order total adjusted for refunds and other adjustments. The calculation used for this field is as follows: total price listed on the original order (including shipping costs and discounts) + adjustments + adjustments tax - total refunds - refunds tax The order_adjusted_total will equate to the total sales - refunds listed within the transactions table for the order (after currency exchange).

avg_order_value.name: avg_order_value
avg_order_value.comment: Average adjusted total per order placed on this day (in shop currency).

shipping_cost.name: shipping_cost
shipping_cost.comment: The shipping cost of the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

order_adjustment_amount.name: order_adjustment_amount
order_adjustment_amount.comment: Total adjustment amount (in shop currency) applied to the orders placed on this day.

order_adjustment_tax_amount.name: order_adjustment_tax_amount
order_adjustment_tax_amount.comment: Total tax applied to adjustments (in shop currency) on the orders placed on this day.

refund_subtotal.name: refund_subtotal
refund_subtotal.comment: Total refund amount applied to the orders placed on this day.

refund_total_tax.name: refund_total_tax
refund_total_tax.comment: Total tax applied to the refund on the orders placed on this day (in shop currency).

total_discounts.name: total_discounts
total_discounts.comment: The total amount of the discount allocated to this day's orders in the shop's currency.

avg_discount.name: avg_discount
avg_discount.comment: Average total discount placed on orders on this day (in shop currency).

shipping_discount_amount.name: shipping_discount_amount
shipping_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping for orders placed on this day.

avg_shipping_discount_amount.name: avg_shipping_discount_amount
avg_shipping_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated toward shipping on orders placed on this day.

percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: percentage_calc_discount_amount
percentage_calc_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based discount for orders placed on this day.

avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.name: avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount
avg_percentage_calc_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a percentage-based-discount on orders placed on this day.

fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: fixed_amount_discount_amount
fixed_amount_discount_amount.comment: The total amount of discount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount discount for orders placed on this day.

avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.name: avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount
avg_fixed_amount_discount_amount.comment: Average discount amount (in shop currency) allocated via a fixed-amount-discount on orders placed on this day.

count_discount_codes_applied.name: count_discount_codes_applied
count_discount_codes_applied.comment: Distinct discount codes applied by customers on orders for this day.

count_locations_ordered_from.name: count_locations_ordered_from
count_locations_ordered_from.comment: Distinct locations with orders placed against them on this day.

count_orders_with_discounts.name: count_orders_with_discounts
count_orders_with_discounts.comment: Count of orders in which a discount was applied.

count_orders_with_refunds.name: count_orders_with_refunds
count_orders_with_refunds.comment: Count of orders in which there was a refund.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: Timestamp of the first order of the day for the shop.

last_order_timestamp.name: last_order_timestamp
last_order_timestamp.comment: Timestamp of the last order of the day for the shop.

quantity_sold.name: quantity_sold
quantity_sold.comment: Total quantity sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

quantity_refunded.name: quantity_refunded
quantity_refunded.comment: The quantity of goods ORDERED on this day that have been refunded.

quantity_net.name: quantity_net
quantity_net.comment: Net quantity sold from this shop on this day. Excludes refunds.

avg_quantity_sold.name: avg_quantity_sold
avg_quantity_sold.comment: Average quantity sold per order on this day. Includes refunds. (in shop currency)

avg_quantity_net.name: avg_quantity_net
avg_quantity_net.comment: Average net quantity sold per order on this day. Excludes refunds. (in shop currency)

count_variants_sold.name: count_variants_sold
count_variants_sold.comment: Distinct product variants sold on this day (includes refunds).

count_products_sold.name: count_products_sold
count_products_sold.comment: Distinct products sold on this day (includes refunds).

quantity_gift_cards_sold.name: quantity_gift_cards_sold
quantity_gift_cards_sold.comment: Quantity of gift cards sold on this day.

quantity_requiring_shipping.name: quantity_requiring_shipping
quantity_requiring_shipping.comment: Quantity of goods sold on this day that require shipping.

gross_sales.name: gross_sales
gross_sales.comment: The total revenue from sales before discounts and returns are applied for this day (in shop currency).

discounts.name: discounts
discounts.comment: The total amount of discounts applied to orders on this day (in shop currency).

returns.name: returns
returns.comment: The total value of goods returned on orders on this day (in shop currency).

net_sales.name: net_sales
net_sales.comment: The net revenue from orders on this day after discounts and returns (gross_sales - discounts - returns, in shop currency).

count_abandoned_checkouts.name: count_abandoned_checkouts
count_abandoned_checkouts.comment: Count of abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customers_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customers_abandoned_checkout
count_customers_abandoned_checkout.comment: Count of distinct customers who abandoned checkouts on this day.

count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.name: count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout
count_customer_emails_abandoned_checkout.comment: Count of distinct customer emails who abandoned checkouts on this day.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: shopify_gql__discounts
metadata.comment: Each record represents a unique discount, enriched with discount metadata and metrics regarding orders and abandoned checkouts.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

discount_code_id.name: discount_code_id
discount_code_id.comment: The ID for the discount code.

applies_once_per_customer.name: applies_once_per_customer
applies_once_per_customer.comment: Whether the discount can be used only once per customer.

usage_count.name: usage_count
usage_count.comment: Number of times the discount has been used (asynchronously updated).

codes_count.name: codes_count
codes_count.comment: Number of unique redeem codes associated with the discount.

codes_precision.name: codes_precision
codes_precision.comment: Indicates whether `codes_count` is exact or estimated.

combines_with_order_discounts.name: combines_with_order_discounts
combines_with_order_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with order-level discounts.

combines_with_product_discounts.name: combines_with_product_discounts
combines_with_product_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with product-level discounts.

combines_with_shipping_discounts.name: combines_with_shipping_discounts
combines_with_shipping_discounts.comment: Whether this discount can be combined with shipping-level discounts.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount was created.

customer_selection_all_customers.name: customer_selection_all_customers
customer_selection_all_customers.comment: Whether the discount is available to all customers.

ends_at.name: ends_at
ends_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount ends or expires.

starts_at.name: starts_at
starts_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount becomes active.

status.name: status
status.comment: Current status of the discount (e.g. 'active', 'expired', 'scheduled').

title.name: title
title.comment: The discount’s display name in the Shopify admin and to customers.

total_sales_amount.name: total_sales_amount
total_sales_amount.comment: The total sales amount that resulted from the usage of this discount.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: Timestamp when the discount was last updated.

usage_limit.name: usage_limit
usage_limit.comment: The total number of times the discount code can be used.

code.name: code
code.comment: The case-insensitive discount code that customers use at checkout.

allocation_method.name: allocation_method
allocation_method.comment: The method by which the discount is allocated. Valid values include `each` (applies the discount to each eligible item) and `across` (spreads the discount value across eligible items).

target_selection.name: target_selection
target_selection.comment: Indicates whether the discount applies to 'all' or 'entitled' items.

target_type.name: target_type
target_type.comment: The type of target this discount applies to (e.g., `line_item` or `shipping_line`).

value_amount.name: value_amount
value_amount.comment: The numerical value of the discount application. A monetary value in decimal format, allowing for precise representation of cents or fractional currency.

value_currency_code.name: value_currency_code
value_currency_code.comment: The three-letter currency code for the discount that represents a world currency used in a store.

value_percentage.name: value_percentage
value_percentage.comment: The percentage discount value that is applied to a line, a number ranging between -100 (free) and 0 (no discount)

value_type.name: value_type
value_type.comment: How the discount value is interpreted (e.g., 'percentage', 'fixed_amount').

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.comment:
Unique key representing a discount.
Hashed on 'source_relation', 'discount_code_id', 'discount_id', 'discount_type',
'code', 'allocation_method', 'target_selection', 'target_type', 'value_amount',
'value_currency_code', 'value_percentage', 'value_type'.

count_orders.name: count_orders
count_orders.comment: Count of orders in which this discount code was applied.

avg_order_discount_amount.name: avg_order_discount_amount
avg_order_discount_amount.comment: Average amount (in shop currency) of discount taken off orders.

total_order_discount_amount.name: total_order_discount_amount
total_order_discount_amount.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off of orders.

total_order_line_items_price.name: total_order_line_items_price
total_order_line_items_price.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of line items for orders that have used this discount.

total_order_shipping_cost.name: total_order_shipping_cost
total_order_shipping_cost.comment: Total shipping costs for orders that used this discount.

total_order_refund_amount.name: total_order_refund_amount
total_order_refund_amount.comment: Total refunded amount (in shop currency) for orders that used this discount code.

count_customers.name: count_customers
count_customers.comment: Count of distinct customers who placed orders using this discount.

count_customer_emails.name: count_customer_emails
count_customer_emails.comment: Count of distinct customer emails who placed orders using this discount.

total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.name: total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount
total_abandoned_checkout_discount_amount.comment: Total monetary amount (in shop currency) of discounts taken off abandoned checkout orders.

count_abandoned_checkouts.name: count_abandoned_checkouts
count_abandoned_checkouts.comment: Count of abandoned checkouts in which this discount code was applied.

count_abandoned_checkout_customers.name: count_abandoned_checkout_customers
count_abandoned_checkout_customers.comment: Distinct count of customers who applied this discount in a checkout that they abandoned.

count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails.name: count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails
count_abandoned_checkout_customer_emails.comment: Distinct count of customer emails who applied this discount in a checkout that they abandoned.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: shopify_gql__inventory_levels
metadata.comment:
Model representing the current status of an inventory level in Shopify. Inventory Levels are unique pairings of  inventory items (which have a 1:1 relationship with product variants) and locations. 
Inventory Level = Inventory item @ a Location.
Will also include `PRODUCT_VARIANT` metafields if enabled.

inventory_level_id.name: inventory_level_id
inventory_level_id.comment: A globally unique identifier for the inventory level.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.comment: The ID of the inventory item associated with the inventory level.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The ID of the location that the inventory level belongs to.

can_deactivate.name: can_deactivate
can_deactivate.comment: Indicates whether the inventory item can be deactivated at the location.

deactivation_alert.name: deactivation_alert
deactivation_alert.comment: Provides an alert message when the inventory item is deactivated at the location.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time when the inventory level was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory level was last modified.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

sku.name: sku
sku.comment: The unique SKU (stock keeping unit) of the inventory item.

is_inventory_item_deleted.name: is_inventory_item_deleted
is_inventory_item_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

unit_cost_amount.name: unit_cost_amount
unit_cost_amount.comment: The unit cost associated with the inventory item.

unit_cost_currency_code.name: unit_cost_currency_code
unit_cost_currency_code.comment: Currency of the unit cost associated with the inventory item.

country_code_of_origin.name: country_code_of_origin
country_code_of_origin.comment: The country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of where the item came from.

province_code_of_origin.name: province_code_of_origin
province_code_of_origin.comment: The province code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2) of where the item came from. The province code is only used if the shipping provider for the inventory item is Canada Post.

is_shipping_required.name: is_shipping_required
is_shipping_required.comment: (DEPRECATED 2025-01-06) Boolean representing whether a customer needs to provide a shipping address when placing an order containing the inventory item.

is_inventory_quantity_tracked.name: is_inventory_quantity_tracked
is_inventory_quantity_tracked.comment: Boolean representing whether inventory levels are tracked for the item. If true, then the inventory quantity changes are tracked by Shopify.

inventory_item_created_at.name: inventory_item_created_at
inventory_item_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was created.

inventory_item_updated_at.name: inventory_item_updated_at
inventory_item_updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was last modified.

duplicate_sku_count.name: duplicate_sku_count
duplicate_sku_count.comment: The number of inventory items that share the same SKU with this item.

harmonized_system_code.name: harmonized_system_code
harmonized_system_code.comment: The harmonized system code of the item.

inventory_history_url.name: inventory_history_url
inventory_history_url.comment: The URL that points to the inventory history for the item.

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id
legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

measurement_id.name: measurement_id
measurement_id.comment: The unique identifier for the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_value.name: measurement_weight_value
measurement_weight_value.comment: The weight value of the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_unit.name: measurement_weight_unit
measurement_weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the inventory item's weight.

is_tracked_editable_locked.name: is_tracked_editable_locked
is_tracked_editable_locked.comment: Indicates whether the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

tracked_editable_reason.name: tracked_editable_reason
tracked_editable_reason.comment: Provides the reason why the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

is_location_deleted.name: is_location_deleted
is_location_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

is_location_active.name: is_location_active
is_location_active.comment: Boolean representing whether the location is active. If true, then the location can be used to sell products, stock inventory, and fulfill orders.

address_2.name: address_2
address_2.comment: The optional second line of the location's street address.

city.name: city
city.comment: The city the location is in.

country.name: country
country.comment: The country the location is in (two-letter code).

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format) corresponding to country the location is in.

country_name.name: country_name
country_name.comment: The name of the country where the inventory level is located.

is_legacy_location.name: is_legacy_location
is_legacy_location.comment: Boolean representing whether this is a fulfillment service location. If true, then the location is a fulfillment service location.  If false, then the location was created by the merchant and isn't tied to a fulfillment service.

province.name: province
province.comment: The province, state, or district of the location.

province_code.name: province_code
province_code.comment: The province, state, or district code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 format) of the location.

phone.name: phone
phone.comment: The phone number of the location. This value can contain special characters, such as - or +.

location_created_at.name: location_created_at
location_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the location was created.

location_updated_at.name: location_updated_at
location_updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the location was last updated.

variant_id.name: variant_id
variant_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the product variant.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the product.

variant_title.name: variant_title
variant_title.comment: The title of the product variant. The title field is a concatenation of the option1, option2, and option3 fields. You can only update title indirectly using the option fields.

variant_inventory_policy.name: variant_inventory_policy
variant_inventory_policy.comment: Whether customers are allowed to place an order for the product variant when it's out of stock.

variant_price.name: variant_price
variant_price.comment: The price of the product variant in shop currency.

is_variant_taxable.name: is_variant_taxable
is_variant_taxable.comment: Whether a tax is charged when the product variant is sold.

variant_barcode.name: variant_barcode
variant_barcode.comment: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product.

variant_inventory_quantity.name: variant_inventory_quantity
variant_inventory_quantity.comment: An aggregate of inventory across all locations. To adjust inventory at a specific location, use the InventoryLevel resource.

variant_tax_code.name: variant_tax_code
variant_tax_code.comment: This parameter applies only to the stores that have the Avalara AvaTax app installed. Specifies the Avalara tax code for the product variant.

variant_created_at.name: variant_created_at
variant_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product variant was created.

variant_updated_at.name: variant_updated_at
variant_updated_at.comment: The date and time when the product variant was last modified. Gets returned in ISO 8601 format.

variant_is_available_for_sale.name: variant_is_available_for_sale
variant_is_available_for_sale.comment: Indicates whether the product variant is available for sale.

variant_display_name.name: variant_display_name
variant_display_name.comment: The display name of the variant, based on the product's title and variant's title.

variant_legacy_resource_id.name: variant_legacy_resource_id
variant_legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

variant_has_components_required.name: variant_has_components_required
variant_has_components_required.comment: Indicates whether a product variant requires components.

variant_sellable_online_quantity.name: variant_sellable_online_quantity
variant_sellable_online_quantity.comment: The total sellable quantity of the variant for online channels.

subtotal_sold.name: subtotal_sold
subtotal_sold.comment: Total amount (monetary, in shop currency) sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

quantity_sold.name: quantity_sold
quantity_sold.comment: Total quantity sold from the inventory level. Includes refunds.

count_distinct_orders.name: count_distinct_orders
count_distinct_orders.comment: The number of distinct orders placed from this inventory level.

count_distinct_customers.name: count_distinct_customers
count_distinct_customers.comment: The number of distinct customers (based on customer_id) that have placed orders against this inventory level.

count_distinct_customer_emails.name: count_distinct_customer_emails
count_distinct_customer_emails.comment: The number of distinct customer emails that have placed orders against this inventory level.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: The timetamp of the first order against this inventory level.

last_order_timestamp.name: last_order_timestamp
last_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp of the first order against this inventory level.

subtotal_sold_refunds.name: subtotal_sold_refunds
subtotal_sold_refunds.comment: The monetary amount (in shop currency) of inventory level goods that have been refunded.

quantity_sold_refunds.name: quantity_sold_refunds
quantity_sold_refunds.comment: The quantity of inventory level goods that have been refunded.

count_fulfillment_pending.name: count_fulfillment_pending
count_fulfillment_pending.comment: Count of currently pending distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Pending" = Shopify has created the fulfillment and is waiting for the third-party fulfillment service to transition it to 'open' or 'success'.

count_fulfillment_open.name: count_fulfillment_open
count_fulfillment_open.comment: Count of currently open distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Open" = The fulfillment has been acknowledged by the service and is in processing.

count_fulfillment_success.name: count_fulfillment_success
count_fulfillment_success.comment: Count of successful distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Success" = The fulfillment was successful.

count_fulfillment_cancelled.name: count_fulfillment_cancelled
count_fulfillment_cancelled.comment: Count of cancelled distinct fulfillments for this inventory level. "Cancelled" = The fulfillment was cancelled.

count_fulfillment_error.name: count_fulfillment_error
count_fulfillment_error.comment: Count of distinct fulfillments for this inventory level that encountered an error. "Error" = There was an error with the fulfillment request.

count_fulfillment_failure.name: count_fulfillment_failure
count_fulfillment_failure.comment: Count of distinct fulfillments for this inventory level that failed. "Failure" = The fulfillment request failed.

incoming_quantity.name: incoming_quantity
incoming_quantity.comment: The incoming quantity on its way to a merchant's location. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

on_hand_quantity.name: on_hand_quantity
on_hand_quantity.comment: The total number of units that are physically at a location. The `on_hand` state equals the sum of inventory quantities that  are in the `available`, `committed`, `reserved`, `damaged`, `safety_stock`, and `quality_control` states. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

available_quantity.name: available_quantity
available_quantity.comment: The available quantity that a merchant can sell, determined by coalescing the `quantity` where  inventory_state_name = 'available' from `stg_shopify_gql__inventory_quantity`and `available_quantity`  from the deprecated `stg_shopify_gql__inventory_level`. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

committed_quantity.name: committed_quantity
committed_quantity.comment: The number of units that are part of a placed order but aren't fulfilled. When a draft order is created, the inventory isn't committed until the draft order is completed and an order is created. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

reserved_quantity.name: reserved_quantity
reserved_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that are temporarily set aside. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

damaged_quantity.name: damaged_quantity
damaged_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that aren't sellable or usable due to damage. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

safety_stock_quantity.name: safety_stock_quantity
safety_stock_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that are set aside to help guard against overselling. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

quality_control_quantity.name: quality_control_quantity
quality_control_quantity.comment: The on-hand units that aren't sellable because they're currently in inspection for quality purposes. Returns null if the inventory item is not tracked.

net_subtotal_sold.name: net_subtotal_sold
