metadata.comment: Each record represents a line item of an order in Shopify.

order_line_id.name: order_line_id
order_line_id.comment: The ID of the line item.

index.name: index
index.comment: The index associated with the order.

name.name: name
name.comment: The name of the product variant.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The ID of the related order.

fulfillment_status.name: fulfillment_status
fulfillment_status.comment: How far along an order is in terms line items fulfilled.

is_gift_card.name: is_gift_card
is_gift_card.comment: Whether the item is a gift card. If true, then the item is not taxed or considered for shipping charges.

price_pres_amount.name: price_pres_amount
price_pres_amount.comment: The total price of the line item when the order was created, in *presentment* currency. This value doesn't include discounts.

price_pres_currency_code.name: price_pres_currency_code
price_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total price.

price_shop_amount.name: price_shop_amount
price_shop_amount.comment: The total price of the line item when the order was created, in *shop* currency. This value doesn't include discounts.

price_shop_currency_code.name: price_shop_currency_code
price_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total price.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: The ID of the product that the line item belongs to. Can be null if the original product associated with the order is deleted at a later date.

quantity.name: quantity
quantity.comment: The number of items that were purchased.

title.name: title
title.comment: The title of the product.

total_discount_pres_amount.name: total_discount_pres_amount
total_discount_pres_amount.comment: The total discount allocated to the line item in *presentment* currency, including the total allocated to refunded and removed quantities. This value doesn't include order-level discounts.

total_discount_pres_currency_code.name: total_discount_pres_currency_code
total_discount_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency currency used to display the total discount.

total_discount_shop_amount.name: total_discount_shop_amount
total_discount_shop_amount.comment: The total discount allocated to the line item in *shop* currency, including the total allocated to refunded and removed quantities. This value doesn't include order-level discounts.

total_discount_shop_currency_code.name: total_discount_shop_currency_code
total_discount_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total discount.

variant_id.name: variant_id
variant_id.comment: The ID of the product variant.

variant_title.name: variant_title
variant_title.comment: The title of the product variant. The title field is a concatenation of the option1, option2, and option3 fields. You can only update title indirectly using the option fields.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.comment: The name of the item's supplier.

_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

unique_key.comment: Unique key representing an order line. Hashed on 'order_line_id' and 'source_relation'.

order_line_tax.name: order_line_tax
order_line_tax.comment: Total taxes for the line item.

fulfillable_quantity.name: fulfillable_quantity
fulfillable_quantity.comment: The amount available to fulfill, calculated as follows: quantity - max(refunded_quantity, fulfilled_quantity) - pending_fulfilled_quantity - open_fulfilled_quantity

weight_unit.name: weight_unit
weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the weight of a single item (e.g., grams, ounces).

weight_value.name: weight_value
weight_value.comment: The numeric weight of a single unit of the line item using the specified `weight_unit`.

restock_types.name: restock_types
restock_types.comment: List of how this refund line item affects inventory levels.

refunded_quantity.name: refunded_quantity
refunded_quantity.comment: Quantity of the item that has been refunded.

refunded_subtotal.name: refunded_subtotal
refunded_subtotal.comment: Subtotal amount of the refund applied to the order line in shop currency.

subtotal_net_refunds.name: subtotal_net_refunds
subtotal_net_refunds.comment: Subtotal of the order line with refunds subtracted in shop currency.

variant_created_at.name: variant_created_at
variant_created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product variant was created.

variant_updated_at.name: variant_updated_at
variant_updated_at.comment: The date and time when the product variant was last modified. Gets returned in ISO 8601 format.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.comment: The unique identifier for the inventory item, which is used in the Inventory API to query for inventory information.

variant_price.name: variant_price
variant_price.comment: The price of the product variant.

variant_sku.name: variant_sku
variant_sku.comment: A unique identifier for the product variant in the shop. Required in order to connect to a FulfillmentService.

variant_position.name: variant_position
variant_position.comment: The order of the product variant in the list of product variants. The first position in the list is 1. The position of variants is indicated by the order in which they are listed.

variant_inventory_policy.name: variant_inventory_policy
variant_inventory_policy.comment: Whether customers are allowed to place an order for the product variant when it's out of stock.

variant_compare_at_price.name: variant_compare_at_price
variant_compare_at_price.comment: The original price of the item before an adjustment or a sale in shop currency.

variant_is_taxable.name: variant_is_taxable
variant_is_taxable.comment: Whether a tax is charged when the product variant is sold.

variant_barcode.name: variant_barcode
variant_barcode.comment: The barcode, UPC, or ISBN number for the product.

variant_inventory_quantity.name: variant_inventory_quantity
variant_inventory_quantity.comment: An aggregate of inventory across all locations. To adjust inventory at a specific location, use the InventoryLevel resource.

variant_weight.name: variant_weight
variant_weight.comment: The weight value of the variant's inventory item's measurement.

variant_weight_unit.name: variant_weight_unit
variant_weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the variant's inventory item's weight.

variant_tax_code.name: variant_tax_code
variant_tax_code.comment: This parameter applies only to the stores that have the Avalara AvaTax app installed. Specifies the Avalara tax code for the product variant.

variant_is_available_for_sale.name: variant_is_available_for_sale
variant_is_available_for_sale.comment: Indicates whether the product variant is available for sale.

variant_display_name.name: variant_display_name
variant_display_name.comment: The display name of the variant, based on the product's title and variant's title.

variant_legacy_resource_id.name: variant_legacy_resource_id
variant_legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

variant_has_components_required.name: variant_has_components_required
variant_has_components_required.comment: Indicates whether a product variant requires components.

variant_sellable_online_quantity.name: variant_sellable_online_quantity
variant_sellable_online_quantity.comment: The total sellable quantity of the variant for online channels.

total_discounts_pres_amount.comment: The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in *presentment* currency. This includes both order and line level discounts.

total_discounts_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency currency used to display the total discounts.

total_discounts_shop_amount.comment: The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in *shop* currency. This includes both order and line level discounts.

total_discounts_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total discounts.

total_price_pres_amount.name: total_price_pres_amount
total_price_pres_amount.comment: The total price of the order, before returns, in *presentment* currency.

total_price_pres_currency_code.name: total_price_pres_currency_code
total_price_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total price.

total_tax_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total tax amount.

subtotal_price_shop_amount.comment: The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in *shop* currency. If taxesIncluded is true, then the subtotal also includes tax.

subtotal_price_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the subtotal price.

has_taxes_included.name: has_taxes_included

total_weight.name: total_weight
total_weight.comment: The sum of all line item weights in grams.

total_tip_received_pres_amount.name: total_tip_received_pres_amount
total_tip_received_pres_amount.comment: The sum of all tip amounts for the order, in *presentment* currency.

billing_address_last_name.comment: The last name of the person associated with the payment method.

shipping_cost_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total shipping costs.

shipping_cost_shop_amount.comment: The total shipping costs returned to the customer, in *shop* currency.

shipping_cost_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total shipping costs.

shipping_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_address_2.name: shipping_address_address_2

shipping_address_latitude.comment: The latitude of the shipping address.

metadata.name: shopify_gql__products
metadata.comment: Each record represents a product in Shopify. Will also include `PRODUCT` metafields if enabled.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: An unsigned 64-bit integer that's used as a unique identifier for the product. Each id is unique across the Shopify system. No two products will have the same id, even if they're from different shops.

handle.name: handle
handle.comment: A unique human-friendly string for the product. Automatically generated from the product's title.

product_type.name: product_type
product_type.comment: A categorization for the product used for filtering and searching products.

title.name: title
title.comment: The name of the product.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.comment: The name of the product's vendor.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the product. Valid values: - active: The product is ready to sell and is available to customers on the online store, sales channels, and apps. By default, existing products are set to active. - archived: The product is no longer being sold and isn't available to customers on sales channels and apps. - draft: The product isn't ready to sell and is unavailable to customers on sales channels and apps. By default, duplicated and unarchived products are set to draft.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Whether the record has been deleted in the source system.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was created.

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was last modified.

published_timestamp.name: published_timestamp
published_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be set to null to unpublish the product from the Online Store channel.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

unique_key.name: unique_key
unique_key.comment: Unique key representing a product. Hashed on 'product_id' and 'source_relation'.

collections.name: collections
collections.comment: Comma-separated list of collections associated with the product.

tags.name: tags
tags.comment: Comma-separated list of tags associated with the product.

subtotal_sold.name: subtotal_sold
subtotal_sold.comment: Total amount (in shop currency) of the product sold.

quantity_sold_net_refunds.name: quantity_sold_net_refunds
quantity_sold_net_refunds.comment: Quantity of the product sold, excluding refunds.

subtotal_sold_net_refunds.name: subtotal_sold_net_refunds
subtotal_sold_net_refunds.comment: Total amount (in shop currency) of the product sold, excluding refunds.

first_order_timestamp.name: first_order_timestamp
first_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp the product was first ordered.

most_recent_order_timestamp.name: most_recent_order_timestamp
most_recent_order_timestamp.comment: The timestamp the product was most recently ordered.

avg_quantity_per_order_line.name: avg_quantity_per_order_line
avg_quantity_per_order_line.comment: Average quantity per order line with this product.

product_total_discount.name: product_total_discount
product_total_discount.comment: Total discounts associated with the product.

product_avg_discount_per_order_line.name: product_avg_discount_per_order_line
product_avg_discount_per_order_line.comment: Average discount per order line with this product.

product_total_tax.comment: Total taxes associated with the product.

product_avg_tax_per_order_line.name: product_avg_tax_per_order_line
product_avg_tax_per_order_line.comment: Average taxes per order line with this product.

return_id.name: return_id

order_line_refund_id.name: order_line_refund_id

order_channel.name: order_channel

refund_created_at.name: refund_created_at

refund_updated_at.name: refund_updated_at
refund_updated_at.comment: The timestamp when the refund was last updated.

days_to_refund.name: days_to_refund
days_to_refund.comment: Number of days between the original order creation date and the refund creation date.

refund_note.name: refund_note
refund_note.comment: An optional note attached to the refund by the merchant or staff.

staff_user_id.name: staff_user_id
staff_user_id.comment: The ID of the staff member who processed the refund.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.comment: The ID of the product associated with the refunded line item.

variant_id.name: variant_id
variant_id.comment: The ID of the product variant associated with the refunded line item.

product_title.name: product_title
product_title.comment: The title of the product at the time of the original order.

sku.name: sku
sku.comment: The SKU of the product variant at the time of the original order.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.comment: The vendor of the product at the time of the original order.

original_total_price_pres_currency_code.name: original_total_price_pres_currency_code
original_total_price_pres_currency_code.comment: The presentment currency code for the original total price.

refund_line_item_quantity.name: refund_line_item_quantity
refund_line_item_quantity.comment: The quantity of items refunded on this line item.

price_shop_amount.name: price_shop_amount
price_shop_amount.comment: The per-unit price of the refunded item in shop currency.

subtotal_shop_amount.name: subtotal_shop_amount
subtotal_shop_amount.comment: The subtotal of the refund for this line item, before tax, in shop currency.

total_tax_shop_amount.name: total_tax_shop_amount
total_tax_shop_amount.comment: The total tax refunded for this line item in shop currency.

total_refunded_line_shop_amount.comment: The total amount refunded for this line item including tax in shop currency. Equal to subtotal_shop_amount + total_tax_shop_amount.

price_pres_amount.comment: The per-unit price of the refunded item in presentment currency.

price_pres_currency_code.comment: The presentment currency code for the per-unit refund price.

subtotal_pres_amount.comment: The subtotal of the refund for this line item, before tax, in presentment currency.

subtotal_pres_currency_code.comment: The presentment currency code for the refund subtotal.

total_tax_pres_amount.comment: The total tax refunded for this line item in presentment currency.

total_tax_pres_currency_code.name: total_tax_pres_currency_code
total_tax_pres_currency_code.comment: The presentment currency code for the refund tax amount.

total_refunded_line_pres_amount.name: total_refunded_line_pres_amount
total_refunded_line_pres_amount.comment: The total amount refunded for this line item including tax in presentment currency. Equal to subtotal_pres_amount + total_tax_pres_amount.

restock_type.comment: How the refunded item was restocked. One of 'return', 'cancel', 'legacy_restock', or 'no_restock'.

restock_location_id.name: restock_location_id
restock_location_id.comment: The ID of the location where the item was restocked, if applicable.

is_restocked.name: is_restocked
is_restocked.comment: Whether the item was physically restocked (restock_type is 'return', 'cancel', or 'legacy_restock').

is_restock_only.name: is_restock_only
is_restock_only.comment: Whether this refund line had no financial value and only restocked inventory (subtotal_shop_amount and total_tax_shop_amount are both zero and the item was restocked).

metadata.name: stg_shopify__collection
metadata.comment: A collection is a grouping of products that merchants can create to make their stores easier to browse. Merchants can create collections by selecting products individually or by defining rules that automatically determine whether products are included (aka a "smart collection").

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

rule_logic.name: rule_logic
rule_logic.comment: Whether the `rules` are disjunctive (logical `OR`) or conjunctive (logical `AND`)

handle.name: handle
handle.comment: A unique, human-readable string for the collection automatically generated from its title. This is used in themes by the Liquid templating language to refer to the collection.

published_scope.name: published_scope
published_scope.comment: Whether the collection is published to the Point of Sale channel. Valid values `web` (the collection is published to the Online Store channel but not published to the Point of Sale channel) and `global` (the collection is published to both the Online Store channel and the Point of Sale channel).

rules.name: rules
rules.comment: An array of rules that define what products go into the smart collection. Each rule (`column` -- `relation` --> `condition`) has these properties: - `column`: the property of a product being used to populate the smart collection. Ex: 'tag', 'type', 'vendor', 'variant_price', etc. - `relation`: The comparative relationship between the column choice, and the condition ('equals', 'contains', 'greater_than', etc.) - condition: Select products for a smart collection using a condition. Values are either strings or numbers, depending on the relation value. See the [Shopify docs](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-rest/2022-10/resources/smartcollection#resource-object) for more.

sort_order.name: sort_order
sort_order.comment: The order of the products in the collection. Valid values incline - `alpha-asc`: The products are sorted alphabetically from A to Z. - `alpha-des`: The products are sorted alphabetically from Z to A. - `best-selling`: The products are sorted by number of sales. - `created`: The products are sorted by the date they were created, from oldest to newest. - `created-desc`: The products are sorted by the date they were created, from newest to oldest. - `manual`: The products are manually sorted by the shop owner. - `price-asc`: The products are sorted by price from lowest to highest. - `price-desc`: The products are sorted by price from highest to lowest.

title.name: title
title.comment: The name of the collection

published_at.name: published_at
published_at.comment: The time and date (ISO 8601 format) when the collection was made visible. Returns null for a hidden collection.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the collection was last modified.

metadata.name: stg_shopify__fulfillment
metadata.comment: A fulfillment order represents a group of one or more items in an order that will be fulfilled from the same location.  A fulfillment represents work that is completed as part of a fulfillment order and can include one or more items.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The unique identifier of the location that the fulfillment was processed at.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the order.

name.name: name
name.comment: The uniquely identifying fulfillment name, consisting of two parts separated by a .. The first part represents the order name and the second part represents the fulfillment number.  The fulfillment number automatically increments depending on how many fulfillments are in an order (e.g. #1001.1, #1001.2).

service.name: service
service.comment: The fulfillment service associated with the fulfillment.

shipment_status.name: shipment_status
shipment_status.comment: The current shipment status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - label_printed: A label for the shipment was purchased and printed. - label_purchased: A label for the shipment was purchased, but not printed. - attempted_delivery: Delivery of the shipment was attempted, but unable to be completed. - ready_for_pickup: The shipment is ready for pickup at a shipping depot. - confirmed: The carrier is aware of the shipment, but hasn't received it yet. - in_transit: The shipment is being transported between shipping facilities on the way to its destination. - out_for_delivery: The shipment is being delivered to its final destination. - delivered: The shipment was successfully delivered. - failure: Something went wrong when pulling tracking information for the shipment, such as the tracking number was invalid or the shipment was canceled.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - pending: Shopify has created the fulfillment and is waiting for the third-party fulfillment service to transition it to 'open' or 'success'. - open: The fulfillment has been acknowledged by the service and is in processing. - success: The fulfillment was successful. - cancelled: The fulfillment was cancelled. - error: There was an error with the fulfillment request. - failure: The fulfillment request failed.

tracking_company.name: tracking_company
tracking_company.comment: The name of the tracking company.

tracking_number.name: tracking_number
tracking_number.comment: Primary tracking number for the order.

tracking_numbers.name: tracking_numbers
tracking_numbers.comment: A list of tracking numbers, provided by the shipping company.

tracking_urls.name: tracking_urls
tracking_urls.comment: The URLs of tracking pages for the fulfillment.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time when the fulfillment was created. The API returns this value in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment was last modified.

_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

metadata.name: stg_shopify__inventory_item
metadata.comment: An inventory item represents a physical good. It holds essential information about the physical good, including its SKU and whether its inventory is tracked. There is a 1:1 relationship between a product variant and an inventory item.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.comment: The ID of the inventory item.

sku.name: sku
sku.comment: The unique SKU (stock keeping unit) of the inventory item.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

unit_cost_amount.name: unit_cost_amount
unit_cost_amount.comment: The unit cost associated with the inventory item. Coalesced with the deprecated `cost` field.

unit_cost_currency_code.name: unit_cost_currency_code
unit_cost_currency_code.comment: Currency of the unit cost associated with the inventory item.

country_code_of_origin.name: country_code_of_origin
country_code_of_origin.comment: The country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of where the item came from.

province_code_of_origin.name: province_code_of_origin
province_code_of_origin.comment: The province code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2) of where the item came from. The province code is only used if the shipping provider for the inventory item is Canada Post.

is_shipping_required.name: is_shipping_required
is_shipping_required.comment: Boolean representing whether a customer needs to provide a shipping address when placing an order containing the inventory item.

is_inventory_quantity_tracked.name: is_inventory_quantity_tracked
is_inventory_quantity_tracked.comment: Boolean representing whether inventory levels are tracked for the item. If true, then the inventory quantity changes are tracked by Shopify.

duplicate_sku_count.name: duplicate_sku_count
duplicate_sku_count.comment: The number of inventory items that share the same SKU with this item.

harmonized_system_code.name: harmonized_system_code
harmonized_system_code.comment: The harmonized system code of the item.

inventory_history_url.name: inventory_history_url
inventory_history_url.comment: The URL that points to the inventory history for the item.

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id
legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

measurement_id.name: measurement_id
measurement_id.comment: The unique identifier for the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_value.name: measurement_weight_value
measurement_weight_value.comment: The weight value of the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_unit.name: measurement_weight_unit
measurement_weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the inventory item's weight.

is_tracked_editable_locked.name: is_tracked_editable_locked
is_tracked_editable_locked.comment: Indicates whether the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

tracked_editable_reason.name: tracked_editable_reason
tracked_editable_reason.comment: Provides the reason why the 'tracked' field for the inventory item is locked from editing.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was last modified.

metadata.name: stg_shopify__metafield
metadata.comment: Metafields are a flexible way to attach additional information to a Shopify resource (e.g. Product, Collection, etc.). Some examples of data stored using metafields include specifications, size charts,  downloadable documents, release dates, images, or part numbers. Metafields are identified by an owner resource, a namespace, and a key and they store a value along with type information for that context.

metafield_id.name: metafield_id
metafield_id.comment: The unique ID of the metafield.

description.name: description
description.comment: A description of the information that the metafield contains.

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.comment: A container for a group of metafields. Grouping metafields within a namespace prevents your metafields from conflicting with other metafields with the same key name. Must have between 3-255 characters.

key.name: key
key.comment: The key of the metafield. Keys can be up to 64 characters long and can contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, and periods.

value.name: value
value.comment: The data to store in the metafield. The value is always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

value_type.name: value_type
value_type.comment: The type of data that the metafield stores in the `value` field. Refer to the [list](https://shopify.dev/apps/metafields/types) of supported types. Coalescing of type and value_type

owner_resource_id.name: owner_resource_id
owner_resource_id.comment: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

owner_resource.name: owner_resource
owner_resource.comment: The type of resource (table) that the metafield is attached to.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was last updated.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

metafield_reference.name: metafield_reference
metafield_reference.comment: Combination of the namespace and key columns. This field is key for metafield mapping in downstream models.

is_most_recent_record.name: is_most_recent_record
is_most_recent_record.comment: Boolean indicating the most up to date record identified by the most recent updated_at field.

metadata.name: stg_shopify__order
metadata.comment: Each record represents an order in Shopify.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The ID of the order, used for API purposes. This is different from the order_number property, which is the ID used by the shop owner and customer.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The ID of the user logged into Shopify POS who processed the order, if applicable.

total_discounts.name: total_discounts
total_discounts.comment: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in the shop currency.

total_discounts_set.name: total_discounts_set
total_discounts_set.comment: The total discounts applied to the price of the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_line_items_price.name: total_line_items_price
total_line_items_price.comment: The sum of all line item prices in the shop currency.

total_line_items_price_set.name: total_line_items_price_set
total_line_items_price_set.comment: The total of all line item prices in shop and presentment currencies.

total_price.name: total_price
total_price.comment: The sum of all line item prices, discounts, shipping, taxes, and tips in the shop currency. Must be positive.

total_price_set.name: total_price_set
total_price_set.comment: The total price of the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_tax_set.name: total_tax_set
total_tax_set.comment: The total tax applied to the order in shop and presentment currencies.

total_tax.name: total_tax
total_tax.comment: The sum of all the taxes applied to the order in th shop currency. Must be positive).

source_name.name: source_name
source_name.comment: Where the order originated. Can be set only during order creation, and is not writeable afterwards.

subtotal_price.name: subtotal_price
subtotal_price.comment: The price of the order in the shop currency after discounts but before shipping, taxes, and tips.

has_taxes_included.name: has_taxes_included
has_taxes_included.comment: Whether taxes are included in the order subtotal.

total_weight.name: total_weight
total_weight.comment: The sum of all line item weights in grams.

total_tip_received.name: total_tip_received
total_tip_received.comment: The sum of all the tips in the order in the shop currency.

landing_site_base_url.name: landing_site_base_url
landing_site_base_url.comment: The URL for the page where the buyer landed when they entered the shop.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The ID of the physical location where the order was processed.

name.name: name
name.comment: The order name, generated by combining the order_number property with the order prefix and suffix that are set in the merchant's general settings.

note.name: note
note.comment: An optional note that a shop owner can attach to the order.

number.name: number
number.comment: The order's position in the shop's count of orders. Numbers are sequential and start at 1.

order_number.name: order_number
order_number.comment: The order 's position in the shop's count of orders starting at 1001. Order numbers are sequential and start at 1001.

cancel_reason.name: cancel_reason
cancel_reason.comment: The reason why the order was canceled.

cart_token.name: cart_token
cart_token.comment: The ID of the cart that's associated with the order.

checkout_token.name: checkout_token
checkout_token.comment: A unique value when referencing the checkout that's associated with the order.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The autogenerated date and time when the order was created in Shopify.

cancelled_timestamp.name: cancelled_timestamp
cancelled_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the order was canceled.

closed_timestamp.name: closed_timestamp
closed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the order was closed (archived).

processed_timestamp.name: processed_timestamp
processed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when an order was processed. This value is the date that appears on your orders and that's used in the analytic reports.

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was last modified.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code for the shop currency.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.comment: The ID of the order's customer.

financial_status.name: financial_status
financial_status.comment: The status of payments associated with the order. Can only be set when the order is created

fulfillment_status.name: fulfillment_status
fulfillment_status.comment: The order's status in terms of fulfilled line items.

referring_site.name: referring_site
referring_site.comment: The website where the customer clicked a link to the shop.

billing_address_address_1.name: billing_address_address_1
billing_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the billing address.

billing_address_address_2.name: billing_address_address_2
billing_address_address_2.comment: An optional additional field for the street address of the billing address.

billing_address_city.name: billing_address_city
billing_address_city.comment: The city, town, or village of the billing address.

billing_address_company.name: billing_address_company
billing_address_company.comment: The company of the person associated with the billing address.

billing_address_country.name: billing_address_country
billing_address_country.comment: The name of the country of the billing address.

billing_address_country_code.name: billing_address_country_code
billing_address_country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the billing address.

billing_address_first_name.name: billing_address_first_name
billing_address_first_name.comment: The first name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_last_name.name: billing_address_last_name
billing_address_last_name.comment: The last name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_latitude.name: billing_address_latitude
billing_address_latitude.comment: The latitude of the billing address.

billing_address_longitude.name: billing_address_longitude
billing_address_longitude.comment: The longitude of the billing address.

billing_address_name.name: billing_address_name
billing_address_name.comment: The full name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_phone.name: billing_address_phone
billing_address_phone.comment: The phone number at the billing address.

billing_address_province.name: billing_address_province
billing_address_province.comment: The name of the region (province, state, prefecture, …) of the billing address.

billing_address_province_code.name: billing_address_province_code
billing_address_province_code.comment: The two-letter abbreviation of the region of the billing address.

billing_address_zip.name: billing_address_zip
billing_address_zip.comment: The postal code (zip, postcode, Eircode, …) of the billing address.

browser_ip.name: browser_ip
browser_ip.comment: The IP address of the browser used by the customer when they placed the order.

total_shipping_price_set.name: total_shipping_price_set
total_shipping_price_set.comment: The total shipping price of the order, excluding discounts and returns, in shop and presentment currencies. If taxes_included is set to true, then total_shipping_price_set includes taxes.

shipping_address_address_1.name: shipping_address_address_1
shipping_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_address_2.name: shipping_address_address_2
shipping_address_address_2.comment: An optional additional field for the street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_city.name: shipping_address_city
shipping_address_city.comment: The city, town, or village of the shipping address.

shipping_address_company.name: shipping_address_company
shipping_address_company.comment: The company of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_country.name: shipping_address_country
shipping_address_country.comment: The name of the country of the shipping address.

shipping_address_country_code.name: shipping_address_country_code
shipping_address_country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the shipping address.

metadata.comment: Each record represents a product in Shopify.

product_id.comment: An unsigned 64-bit integer that's used as a unique identifier for the product. Each id is unique across the Shopify system. No two products will have the same id, even if they're from different shops.

handle.name: handle
handle.comment: A unique human-friendly string for the product. Automatically generated from the product's title.

product_type.name: product_type
product_type.comment: A categorization for the product used for filtering and searching products.

published_scope.name: published_scope
published_scope.comment: (DEPRECATED) Whether the product is published to the Point of Sale channel. This field now returns null following a connector update and will be removed in a future release.

title.name: title
title.comment: The name of the product.

vendor.name: vendor
vendor.comment: The name of the product's vendor.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the product. Valid values: - active: The product is ready to sell and is available to customers on the online store, sales channels, and apps. By default, existing products are set to active. - archived: The product is no longer being sold and isn't available to customers on sales channels and apps. - draft: The product isn't ready to sell and is unavailable to customers on sales channels and apps. By default, duplicated and unarchived products are set to draft.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Whether the record has been deleted in the source system.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was created.

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was last modified.

published_timestamp.name: published_timestamp
published_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be set to null to unpublish the product from the Online Store channel.

is_taxable.name: is_taxable

barcode.name: barcode

inventory_quantity.name: inventory_quantity
inventory_quantity.comment: An aggregate of inventory across all locations. To adjust inventory at a specific location, use the InventoryLevel resource.

is_available_for_sale.name: is_available_for_sale

display_name.name: display_name

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id
legacy_resource_id.comment: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

has_components_required.name: has_components_required
has_components_required.comment: Indicates whether a product variant requires components.

sellable_online_quantity.name: sellable_online_quantity
sellable_online_quantity.comment: The total sellable quantity of the variant for online channels.

tax_code.name: tax_code
tax_code.comment: This parameter applies only to the stores that have the Avalara AvaTax app installed. Specifies the Avalara tax code for the product variant.

shop_id.comment: The ID for the shop. A 64-bit unsigned integer.

name.name: name
name.comment: The name of the shop.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

address_2.name: address_2
address_2.comment: The optional second line of the shop's street address.

province.name: province
province.comment: The shop's normalized province or state name.

province_code.name: province_code
province_code.comment: The two- or three-letter code for the shop's province or state.

country.name: country
country.comment: The shop's country. In most cases, this value matches the country_code.

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.comment: The two-letter country code corresponding to the shop's country.

zip.name: zip
zip.comment: The shop's zip or postal code.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.comment: The latitude of the shop's location.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.comment: The longitude of the shop's location.

has_county_taxes.name: has_county_taxes
has_county_taxes.comment: Boolean representing whether the shop is applying taxes on a per-county basis. Only applicable to shops based in the US. Either `true` or `null` (not false, according to Shopify API docs).

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop's default currency.

enabled_presentment_currencies.name: enabled_presentment_currencies
enabled_presentment_currencies.comment: An array of of enabled currencies (ISO 4217 format) that the shop accepts. Merchants can enable currencies from their Shopify Payments settings in the Shopify Admin.

customer_email.name: customer_email
customer_email.comment: The contact email used for communication between the shop owner and the customer.

email.name: email
email.comment: The contact email used for communication between Shopify and the shop owner.

phone.name: phone

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__fulfillment
metadata.comment: A fulfillment order represents a group of one or more items in an order that will be fulfilled from the same location.  A fulfillment represents work that is completed as part of a fulfillment order and can include one or more items.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The unique identifier of the location that the fulfillment was processed at.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The unique numeric identifier for the order.

name.name: name
name.comment: The uniquely identifying fulfillment name, consisting of two parts separated by a .. The first part represents the order name and the second part represents the fulfillment number.  The fulfillment number automatically increments depending on how many fulfillments are in an order (e.g. #1001.1, #1001.2).

service.name: service
service.comment: The fulfillment service associated with the fulfillment.

shipment_status.name: shipment_status
shipment_status.comment: The current shipment status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - label_printed: A label for the shipment was purchased and printed. - label_purchased: A label for the shipment was purchased, but not printed. - attempted_delivery: Delivery of the shipment was attempted, but unable to be completed. - ready_for_pickup: The shipment is ready for pickup at a shipping depot. - confirmed: The carrier is aware of the shipment, but hasn't received it yet. - in_transit: The shipment is being transported between shipping facilities on the way to its destination. - out_for_delivery: The shipment is being delivered to its final destination. - delivered: The shipment was successfully delivered. - failure: Something went wrong when pulling tracking information for the shipment, such as the tracking number was invalid or the shipment was canceled.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the fulfillment. Valid values include: - pending: Shopify has created the fulfillment and is waiting for the third-party fulfillment service to transition it to 'open' or 'success'. - open: The fulfillment has been acknowledged by the service and is in processing. - success: The fulfillment was successful. - cancelled: The fulfillment was cancelled. - error: There was an error with the fulfillment request. - failure: The fulfillment request failed.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time when the fulfillment was created. The API returns this value in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment was last modified.

unit_cost_currency_code.name: unit_cost_currency_code

province_code_of_origin.name: province_code_of_origin

is_inventory_quantity_tracked.name: is_inventory_quantity_tracked

duplicate_sku_count.name: duplicate_sku_count

harmonized_system_code.name: harmonized_system_code

inventory_history_url.name: inventory_history_url

legacy_resource_id.name: legacy_resource_id

measurement_id.name: measurement_id
measurement_id.comment: The unique identifier for the inventory item's measurement.

measurement_weight_value.name: measurement_weight_value

measurement_weight_unit.name: measurement_weight_unit
measurement_weight_unit.comment: The unit of measurement for the inventory item's weight.

is_tracked_editable_locked.name: is_tracked_editable_locked

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__metafield
metadata.comment: Metafields are a flexible way to attach additional information to a Shopify resource (e.g. Product, Collection, etc.). Some examples of data stored using metafields include specifications, size charts,  downloadable documents, release dates, images, or part numbers. Metafields are identified by an owner resource, a namespace, and a key and they store a value along with type information for that context.

metafield_id.name: metafield_id
metafield_id.comment: The unique ID of the metafield.

description.name: description
description.comment: A description of the information that the metafield contains.

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.comment: A container for a group of metafields. Grouping metafields within a namespace prevents your metafields from conflicting with other metafields with the same key name. Must have between 3-255 characters.

key.name: key
key.comment: The key of the metafield. Keys can be up to 64 characters long and can contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, and periods.

value.name: value
value.comment: The data to store in the metafield. The value is always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

owner_resource_id.name: owner_resource_id
owner_resource_id.comment: The unique ID of the resource that the metafield is attached to.

owner_resource.name: owner_resource
owner_resource.comment: The type of resource (table) that the metafield is attached to.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the metafield was last updated.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: The time when a record was last updated by Fivetran.

metafield_reference.name: metafield_reference
metafield_reference.comment: Combination of the namespace and key columns. This field is key for metafield mapping in downstream models.

is_most_recent_record.name: is_most_recent_record
is_most_recent_record.comment: Boolean indicating the most up to date record identified by the most recent updated_at field.

source_relation.comment: The schema or database this record came from if you are making use of the `shopify_union_schemas` or `shopify_union_databases` variables, respectively. Empty string if you are not using either of these variables to union together multiple Shopify connectors.

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__order
metadata.comment: Each record represents an order in Shopify.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: A globally-unique ID.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The staff member who created or is responsible for the order. Useful for tracking which team member handled phone orders, manual orders, or order modifications.  Returns null for orders created directly by customers through the online store.

total_discounts_pres_amount.name: total_discounts_pres_amount
total_discounts_pres_amount.comment: The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in *presentment* currency. This includes both order and line level discounts.

total_discounts_pres_currency_code.name: total_discounts_pres_currency_code
total_discounts_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency currency used to display the total discounts.

total_discounts_shop_amount.name: total_discounts_shop_amount
total_discounts_shop_amount.comment: The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in *shop* currency. This includes both order and line level discounts.

total_discounts_shop_currency_code.name: total_discounts_shop_currency_code
total_discounts_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total discounts.

total_price_pres_amount.name: total_price_pres_amount
total_price_pres_amount.comment: The total price of the order, before returns, in *presentment* currency.

total_price_pres_currency_code.name: total_price_pres_currency_code
total_price_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total price.

total_price_shop_amount.name: total_price_shop_amount
total_price_shop_amount.comment: The total price of the order, before returns, in *shop* currency.

total_price_shop_currency_code.name: total_price_shop_currency_code
total_price_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total price.

total_tax_pres_amount.name: total_tax_pres_amount
total_tax_pres_amount.comment: The total tax amount of the order, before returns, in *presentment* currency.

total_tax_pres_currency_code.name: total_tax_pres_currency_code
total_tax_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total tax amount.

total_tax_shop_amount.name: total_tax_shop_amount
total_tax_shop_amount.comment: The total tax amount of the order, before returns, in *shop* currency.

total_tax_shop_currency_code.name: total_tax_shop_currency_code
total_tax_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total tax amount.

source_name.name: source_name
source_name.comment: The name of the source associated with the order, such as "web", "mobile_app", or "pos". Use this field to identify the platform where the order was placed.

subtotal_price_pres_amount.name: subtotal_price_pres_amount
subtotal_price_pres_amount.comment: The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in shop presentment currency. If taxesIncluded is true, then the subtotal also includes tax.

subtotal_price_pres_currency_code.name: subtotal_price_pres_currency_code
subtotal_price_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the subtotal price.

subtotal_price_shop_amount.name: subtotal_price_shop_amount
subtotal_price_shop_amount.comment: The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in *shop* currency. If taxesIncluded is true, then the subtotal also includes tax.

subtotal_price_shop_currency_code.name: subtotal_price_shop_currency_code
subtotal_price_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the subtotal price.

has_taxes_included.name: has_taxes_included
has_taxes_included.comment: Whether taxes are included in the order subtotal.

total_weight.name: total_weight
total_weight.comment: The sum of all line item weights before returns, in grams.

total_tip_received_pres_amount.name: total_tip_received_pres_amount
total_tip_received_pres_amount.comment: The sum of all tip amounts for the order, in *presentment* currency.

total_tip_received_pres_currency_code.name: total_tip_received_pres_currency_code
total_tip_received_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total tips received.

total_tip_received_shop_amount.name: total_tip_received_shop_amount
total_tip_received_shop_amount.comment: The sum of all tip amounts for the order, in *shop* currency.

total_tip_received_shop_currency_code.name: total_tip_received_shop_currency_code
total_tip_received_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total tips received.

location_id.name: location_id
location_id.comment: The ID of the physical location where the order was processed.

name.name: name
name.comment: The unique identifier for the order that appears on the order page in the Shopify admin and the Order status page. For example, "#1001", "EN1001", or "1001-A". This value isn't unique across multiple stores.

note.name: note
note.comment: The optional note associated with the order. Contains additional information or instructions added by merchants or customers during the order process. Commonly used for special delivery instructions, gift messages, or internal processing notes.

number.name: number
number.comment: The order number used to generate the name using the store's configured order number prefix/suffix. This number isn't guaranteed to follow a consecutive integer sequence (e.g. 1, 2, 3..), nor is it guaranteed to be unique across multiple stores, or even for a single store.

cancel_reason.name: cancel_reason
cancel_reason.comment: The reason why the order was canceled.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The autogenerated date and time when the order was created in Shopify.

cancelled_timestamp.name: cancelled_timestamp
cancelled_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the order was canceled.

closed_timestamp.name: closed_timestamp
closed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the order was closed (archived).

processed_timestamp.name: processed_timestamp
processed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when an order was processed. This value is the date that appears on your orders and that's used in the analytic reports.

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the order was last modified.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The shop currency when the order was placed. For example, "USD" or "CAD".

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.comment: The ID of the order's customer.

financial_status.name: financial_status
financial_status.comment: An order's financial status for display in the Shopify admin. See possible values [here](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.displayFinancialStatus).

fulfillment_status.name: fulfillment_status
fulfillment_status.comment: The order's fulfillment status that displays in the Shopify admin to merchants. For example, an order might be unfulfilled or scheduled. See possible values [here](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.displayFulfillmentStatus).

billing_address_address_1.name: billing_address_address_1
billing_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the billing address.

billing_address_address_2.name: billing_address_address_2
billing_address_address_2.comment: An optional additional field for the street address of the billing address.

billing_address_city.name: billing_address_city
billing_address_city.comment: The city, town, or village of the billing address.

billing_address_company.name: billing_address_company
billing_address_company.comment: The company of the person associated with the billing address.

billing_address_country.name: billing_address_country
billing_address_country.comment: The name of the country of the billing address.

billing_address_country_code.name: billing_address_country_code
billing_address_country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the billing address.

billing_address_first_name.name: billing_address_first_name
billing_address_first_name.comment: The first name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_last_name.name: billing_address_last_name
billing_address_last_name.comment: The last name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_latitude.name: billing_address_latitude
billing_address_latitude.comment: The latitude of the billing address.

billing_address_longitude.name: billing_address_longitude
billing_address_longitude.comment: The longitude of the billing address.

billing_address_name.name: billing_address_name
billing_address_name.comment: The full name of the person associated with the payment method.

billing_address_phone.name: billing_address_phone
billing_address_phone.comment: The phone number at the billing address.

billing_address_province.name: billing_address_province
billing_address_province.comment: The name of the region (province, state, prefecture, …) of the billing address.

billing_address_province_code.name: billing_address_province_code
billing_address_province_code.comment: The two-letter abbreviation of the region of the billing address.

billing_address_zip.name: billing_address_zip
billing_address_zip.comment: The postal code (zip, postcode, Eircode, …) of the billing address.

browser_ip.name: browser_ip
browser_ip.comment: The IP address of the customer who placed the order. Useful for fraud detection and geographic analysis.

shipping_cost_pres_amount.name: shipping_cost_pres_amount
shipping_cost_pres_amount.comment: The total shipping costs returned to the customer, in *presentment* currency.

shipping_cost_pres_currency_code.name: shipping_cost_pres_currency_code
shipping_cost_pres_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the presentment currency used to display the total shipping costs.

shipping_cost_shop_amount.name: shipping_cost_shop_amount
shipping_cost_shop_amount.comment: The total shipping costs returned to the customer, in *shop* currency.

shipping_cost_shop_currency_code.name: shipping_cost_shop_currency_code
shipping_cost_shop_currency_code.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop currency used to display the total shipping costs.

shipping_address_address_1.name: shipping_address_address_1
shipping_address_address_1.comment: The street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_address_2.name: shipping_address_address_2
shipping_address_address_2.comment: An optional additional field for the street address of the shipping address.

shipping_address_city.name: shipping_address_city
shipping_address_city.comment: The city, town, or village of the shipping address.

shipping_address_company.name: shipping_address_company
shipping_address_company.comment: The company of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_country.name: shipping_address_country
shipping_address_country.comment: The name of the country of the shipping address.

shipping_address_country_code.name: shipping_address_country_code
shipping_address_country_code.comment: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the shipping address.

shipping_address_first_name.name: shipping_address_first_name
shipping_address_first_name.comment: The first name of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_last_name.name: shipping_address_last_name
shipping_address_last_name.comment: The last name of the person associated with the shipping address.

shipping_address_latitude.name: shipping_address_latitude
shipping_address_latitude.comment: The latitude of the shipping address.

shipping_address_longitude.name: shipping_address_longitude
shipping_address_longitude.comment: The longitude of the shipping address.

shipping_address_name.name: shipping_address_name
shipping_address_name.comment: The full name of the person associated with the payment method.

shipping_address_phone.name: shipping_address_phone

By default, existing products are set to active. - archived: The product is no longer being sold and isn't available to customers on sales channels and apps. - draft: The product isn't ready to sell and is unavailable to customers on sales channels and apps. By default, duplicated and unarchived products are set to draft.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp

updated_timestamp.name: updated_timestamp
updated_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the product was last modified.

published_timestamp.name: published_timestamp
published_timestamp.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be set to null to unpublish the product from the Online Store channel.

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__shop
metadata.comment: The Shop resource is a collection of general business and store management settings and information about the store.

shop_id.name: shop_id
shop_id.comment: The ID for the shop. A 64-bit unsigned integer.

name.name: name
name.comment: The name of the shop.

is_deleted.name: is_deleted
is_deleted.comment: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Shopify.

address_2.name: address_2
address_2.comment: The optional second line of the shop's street address.

province.name: province
province.comment: The shop's normalized province or state name.

province_code.name: province_code
province_code.comment: The two- or three-letter code for the shop's province or state.

country.name: country
country.comment: The shop's country. In most cases, this value matches the country_code.

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.comment: The two-letter country code corresponding to the shop's country.

zip.name: zip
zip.comment: The shop's zip or postal code.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.comment: The latitude of the shop's location.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.comment: The longitude of the shop's location.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the shop's default currency.

enabled_presentment_currencies.name: enabled_presentment_currencies
enabled_presentment_currencies.comment: An array of of enabled currencies (ISO 4217 format) that the shop accepts. Merchants can enable currencies from their Shopify Payments settings in the Shopify Admin.

customer_email.name: customer_email
customer_email.comment: The contact email used for communication between the shop owner and the customer.

email.name: email
email.comment: The contact email used for communication between Shopify and the shop owner.

phone.name: phone
phone.comment: The contact phone number for the shop.

timezone_offset_minutes.name: timezone_offset_minutes
timezone_offset_minutes.comment: The shop's time zone offset expressed as a number of minutes.

iana_timezone.name: iana_timezone
iana_timezone.comment: The name of the timezone assigned by the [IANA](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

primary_locale.name: primary_locale
primary_locale.comment: The shop's primary locale, as configured in the language settings of the shop's theme.

weight_unit.name: weight_unit
weight_unit.comment: The default unit of weight measurement for the shop.

shop_owner.name: shop_owner
shop_owner.comment: The username of the shop owner.

has_shipping_taxes.name: has_shipping_taxes
has_shipping_taxes.comment: Boolean representing whether taxes are charged for shipping. Valid values are true or false.

has_taxes_included_in_price.name: has_taxes_included_in_price
has_taxes_included_in_price.comment: Boolean representing whether applicable taxes are included in product prices. Valid values are true or null.

has_storefront.name: has_storefront
has_storefront.comment: Boolean representing whether this shop has an online store.

has_checkout_api_supported.name: has_checkout_api_supported
has_checkout_api_supported.comment: Boolean representing whether the shop is capable of accepting payments directly through the Checkout API.

money_format.name: money_format
money_format.comment: A string representing the way currency is formatted when the currency isn't specified.

money_in_emails_format.name: money_in_emails_format
money_in_emails_format.comment: A string representing the way currency is formatted in email notifications when the currency isn't specified.

money_with_currency_format.name: money_with_currency_format
money_with_currency_format.comment: A string representing the way currency is formatted when the currency is specified.

money_with_currency_in_emails_format.name: money_with_currency_in_emails_format
money_with_currency_in_emails_format.comment: A string representing the way currency is formatted in email notifications when the currency is specified.

plan_display_name.name: plan_display_name
plan_display_name.comment: The display name of the Shopify plan the shop is on.

is_password_enabled.name: is_password_enabled
is_password_enabled.comment: Boolean representing whether the password protection page is enabled on the shop's online store.

is_setup_required.name: is_setup_required
is_setup_required.comment: Boolean representing whether the shop has any outstanding setup steps.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601) when the shop was created.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601) when the shop was last updated.

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__tax_line
metadata.comment: Represents a single tax applied to the associated line item.

index.name: index
index.comment: The index of the tax line.

order_line_id.name: order_line_id
order_line_id.comment: The order line that this tax line is associated with.

price_pres_amount.name: price_pres_amount
price_pres_amount.comment: The amount of tax in customer currency after discounts and before returns.

price_pres_currency_code.name: price_pres_currency_code
price_pres_currency_code.comment: The three letter currency code for the tax the customer pays.

price_shop_amount.name: price_shop_amount
price_shop_amount.comment: The amount of tax in shop currency after discounts and before returns.

price_shop_currency_code.name: price_shop_currency_code
price_shop_currency_code.comment: The three letter currency code for the tax from the shop.

rate.name: rate
rate.comment: The proportion of the line item price that the tax represents as a decimal.

title.name: title
title.comment: The name of the tax.

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__tender_transaction
metadata.comment: Each tender transaction represents money passing between the merchant and a customer. A tender transaction with a positive amount  represents a transaction where the customer paid money to the merchant. A negative amount represents a transaction where the  merchant refunded money back to the customer. Tender transactions represent transactions that modify the shop's balance.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The ID of the order that the tender transaction belongs to.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: The amount of the tender transaction in the shop's currency.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: The three-letter code (ISO 4217 format) for the currency used for the tender transaction.

payment_method.name: payment_method
payment_method.comment: Information about the payment method used for this transaction. Valid values include: - credit_card - cash - android_pay - apple_pay - google_pay - samsung_pay - shopify_pay - amazon - klarna - paypal - unknown - other

remote_reference.name: remote_reference
remote_reference.comment: The remote (gateway) reference associated with the tender.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The ID of the user logged into the Shopify POS device that processed the tender transaction, if applicable.

processed_at.name: processed_at
processed_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the tender transaction was processed.

metadata.name: stg_shopify_gql__transaction
metadata.comment: Each record represents a transaction in Shopify.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.comment: The ID for the order that the transaction is associated with.

refund_id.name: refund_id
refund_id.comment: The ID associated with a refund in the refund table.

amount_pres.name: amount_pres
amount_pres.comment: The amount of the transaction in the customer currency.

amount_shop.name: amount_shop
amount_shop.comment: The amount of the transaction in the shop currency.

gateway.name: gateway
gateway.comment: The name of the gateway the transaction was issued through.

amount_pres_currency_code.name: amount_pres_currency_code
amount_pres_currency_code.comment: The three letter currency code of the customer currency.

amount_shop_currency_code.name: amount_shop_currency_code
amount_shop_currency_code.comment: The three letter currency code of the shop's transaction currency.

parent_id.name: parent_id
parent_id.comment: The ID of an associated transaction.

payment_avs_result_code.name: payment_avs_result_code
payment_avs_result_code.comment: The response code from the address verification system.

payment_credit_card_bin.name: payment_credit_card_bin
payment_credit_card_bin.comment: The issuer identification number (IIN), formerly known as bank identification number (BIN) of the customer's credit card.

payment_cvv_result_code.name: payment_cvv_result_code
payment_cvv_result_code.comment: The response code from the credit card company indicating whether the customer entered the card security code, or card verification value, correctly.

payment_credit_card_number.name: payment_credit_card_number
payment_credit_card_number.comment: The customer's credit card number, with most of the leading digits redacted.

payment_credit_card_company.name: payment_credit_card_company
payment_credit_card_company.comment: The name of the company that issued the customer's credit card.

receipt.name: receipt
receipt.comment: A transaction receipt attached to the transaction by the gateway.

currency_exchange_adjustment.name: currency_exchange_adjustment
currency_exchange_adjustment.comment: The difference between the amounts on the associated transaction and the parent transaction.

currency_exchange_original_amount.name: currency_exchange_original_amount
currency_exchange_original_amount.comment: The amount of the parent transaction in the shop currency.

currency_exchange_final_amount.name: currency_exchange_final_amount
currency_exchange_final_amount.comment: The amount of the associated transaction in the shop currency.

error_code.name: error_code
error_code.comment: A standardized error code, independent of the payment provider.

status.name: status
status.comment: The status of the transaction.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: The ID for the user who was logged into the Shopify POS device when the order was processed, if applicable.

authorization_code.name: authorization_code
authorization_code.comment: The authorization code associated with the transaction.

created_timestamp.name: created_timestamp
created_timestamp.comment: The date and time when the transaction was created.

processed_timestamp.name: processed_timestamp
processed_timestamp.comment: The date and time when a transaction was processed.

authorization_expires_at.name: authorization_expires_at
authorization_expires_at.comment: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the Shopify Payments authorization expires.
